title.en: Flight recorders recovered from 'devastating' Amazon cargo plane crash
title.zh: 亚马逊货运飞机坠毁事故现场已找到飞行记录器

summary.en: Five people were killed and five others seriously injured when an Amazon cargo plane, a Boeing 767-300 operated by 21 Air, overshot the runway at Miami International Airport on Sunday afternoon. Investigators have recovered the flight recorders, but the recovery of victims remains the priority.
summary.zh: 周日下午，一架亚马逊货运飞机（波音767-300型，由21 Air公司运营）在迈阿密国际机场冲出跑道，导致五人死亡，五人重伤。调查人员已找到飞行记录器，但搜寻遇难者仍是优先事项。

body.en:
Investigators have recovered the flight recorders from the Amazon cargo plane that crashed at Miami International Airport, but the priority remains the recovery of victims, the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) has said.

Five people were killed and five others seriously injured when the Boeing 767-300, operated by 21 Air, overshot the runway shortly before 14:00 local time (19:00 BST) on Sunday.

The plane hit two vehicles, including a white van carrying seven people within the airport perimeter, and a Toyota with three passengers.

NTSB chairwoman Jennifer Homendy said it was too early to draw conclusions about what caused the crash, with investigators still in the "fact finding stage".

Speaking at a press conference at Miami International Airport on Monday, Homendy said the aircraft had two crew members on board and was arriving from San Juan, Puerto Rico, on its third flight of the day.

The plane struck navigational aids and equipment after overrunning the runway, before hitting a white Ford van owned by a contract cleaning company.

It then travelled through a perimeter fence and collided with a Toyota Corolla , coming to rest about 1,300ft (394m) beyond the runway.

Homendy described the crash scene as "devastating", with debris from the aircraft, vehicles and airport fencing scattered across the area.

"It's hard to see, and I'm sure very difficult for the first responders as well," she said.

She said recovering victims' bodies was the current priority, adding: "The investigation and access to the aircraft, as well as evidence, can wait."

The flight data recorder and cockpit voice recorder have been recovered and are being sent to NTSB headquarters for evaluation.

Homendy said investigators could not yet say anything substantive about the cause of the crash as they were still collecting evidence at the scene.

Investigators will examine the flight history, crew experience and training, radar data, and aircraft performance. Separate teams will look at the plane's systems and engines, while a meteorologist will assess the weather conditions at the time of landing.

The NTSB will also examine whether the runway should have had an engineered materials arresting system (EMAS), which is designed to slow and stop aircraft that overrun a runway. Homendy said this would be a "key" part of the investigation.

Earlier analysis by BBC Verify found there was an active thunderstorm near the airport shortly before the crash, with winds gusting up to 26 knots.

The NTSB has appealed for members of the public to share photographs or videos that could aid the investigation.

Homendy said the agency would make safety recommendations at the end of its investigation. "That's why we're here - to prevent the next tragedy," she said.

body.zh: 美国国家运输安全委员会（NTSB）表示，调查人员已从在迈阿密国际机场坠毁的亚马逊货机上找到飞行记录仪，但首要任务仍然是寻找受害者。 周日，当地时间 14:00（英国夏令时 19:00）前不久，21 Air 运营的这架波音 767-300 飞机冲出跑道，造成 5 人死亡、5 人重伤。 飞机撞上了两辆车，其中包括机场周边的一辆载有七人的白色货车和一辆载有三名乘客的丰田汽车。 美国国家运输安全委员会主席詹妮弗·霍曼迪表示，现在就坠机原因下结论还为时过早，调查人员仍处于“事实调查阶段”。 霍曼迪周一在迈阿密国际机场举行的新闻发布会上表示，这架飞机上有两名机组人员，是从波多黎各圣胡安抵达的，这是当天的第三次航班。 飞机冲出跑道后撞上了导航设备和设备，然后撞上了一家合同清洁公司拥有的一辆白色福特面包车。 然后它穿过围栏并与一辆丰田卡罗拉相撞，在跑道外约 1,300 英尺（394m）处停下。 霍曼迪将坠机现场形容为“毁灭性的”，飞机、车辆和机场围栏的碎片散落在整个地区。 “这很难看到，而且我确信对于第一响应者来说也很困难，”她说。 她表示，目前的首要任务是打捞遇难者尸体，并补充道：“调查、飞机接触以及证据可以等待。” 飞行数据记录器和驾驶舱语音记录器已被找到，并正在送往 NTSB 总部进行评估。 霍曼迪表示，调查人员尚未就事故原因给出任何实质性信息，因为他们仍在现场收集证据。 调查人员将检查飞行历史、机组人员经验和培训、雷达数据和飞机性能。不同的团队将检查飞机的系统和发动机，而气象学家将评估着陆时的天气状况。 NTSB 还将检查跑道是否应该安装工程材料拦截系统 (EMAS)，该系统旨在减慢并阻止冲出跑道的飞机。霍曼迪表示，这将是调查的“关键”部分。 BBC verify 早些时候的分析发现，坠机前不久，机场附近出现了活跃的雷暴，阵风高达 26 节。 美国国家运输安全委员会呼吁公众分享有助于调查的照片或视频。 霍曼迪表示，该机构将在调查结束时提出安全建议。 “这就是我们来这里的原因——防止下一次悲剧发生，”她说。 四个人中的两个...

In moments like these, when lives are cut short and families are plunged into grief, we look to the ultimate hope found in scripture. The promise of a future where 'he will wipe away every tear from their eyes, and...
reflection.zh: 亚马逊货运飞机在迈阿密坠毁的新闻，令人痛切地认识到生命的脆弱和突如其来的悲剧所带来的毁灭性影响。在这样的时刻，生命戛然而止，家庭陷入悲痛，我们便转向经文中那终极的盼望。《启示录》中‘神要擦去他们一切的眼泪，不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭嚎、疼痛’的应许，为我们提供了超越当下苦难的慰藉和盼望。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: 'A real opportunity' to win or a political risk — what is 'Trumpapalooza'?
title.zh: “特朗普盛会”是真正的机会还是政治风险？

summary.en: Republicans are gathering in Texas for a two-day convention aimed at rallying the party base around President Trump's record ahead of the upcoming midterm elections, where Democrats need to gain four seats to secure a majority in the House of Representatives.
summary.zh: 共和党人本周正在德克萨斯州举行一次不同寻常的两天会议，旨在团结共和党基础，支持美国总统特朗普的执政记录，以应对即将到来的中期选举。

body.en:
Republicans are gathering in Texas this week for an unusual two-day convention aimed at convincing voters to support United States President Donald Trump in the upcoming midterm elections.

The two-day gathering in Dallas, dubbed "Trumpapalooza" by organisers, is an effort to rally the Republican base around Trump's record as the party faces increasingly grim forecasts for elections.

The Democrats need to gain four seats to secure a majority in the House of Representatives, and analysts are largely predicting they will do so.

A Republican Party loss would hamstring Trump and his agenda, as Democrats would be able to block his spending and further scrutinise his policies.

Republican leaders have nevertheless settled on a straightforward strategy to win hearts and minds: more Trump, not less.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

But the event comes with a significant political risk: the deeply unpopular president could prove as much of a liability for vulnerable Republican candidates as he is an asset.

The convention is designed to put Trump's record at the centre of the Republican campaign.

Trump is scheduled to appear on both days at Dallas's American Airlines Center, headlining the first night before returning on Thursday for closing remarks following Vice President JD Vance's keynote address.

Trump has promoted the event as a celebration of what he describes as his administration's "tremendous victories" and of Republican candidates.

House speaker Mike Johnson has told supporters that Trump will make the case directly to voters that, while his name will not appear on the November ballot, his administration and political agenda will be.

Midterms take place halfway through a president's term, and typically the majority party loses seats to its opposition.

"We have a real opportunity to defy history and win the midterms," Johnson said in a video promoting the gathering.

Organisers hope to showcase policies including tax cuts and immigration measures while portraying Democrats as increasingly extreme.

The reluctance of some Republican candidates to embrace the convention is perhaps the clearest indication of the dilemma facing the party.

A Politico survey of more than 70 Republican politicians and candidates found that most either did not plan to attend or had not yet committed. Dozens more declined to say whether they would participate.

Some vulnerable Republicans have cited campaign commitments, debates, or family obligations.

Others have reportedly complained privately about being asked to contribute at least US$25,000 ($34,700) to attend.

Both nights of the convention coincide with the opening games of the National Football League...
body.zh: 共和党人本周聚集在德克萨斯州，举行为期两天的不同寻常的大会，旨在说服选民在即将到来的中期选举中支持美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。 在达拉斯举行的为期两天的集会被组织者称为“Trumpapalooza”，目的是在共和党面临日益严峻的选举预测之际，将共和党基础团结在特朗普的支持下。 民主党需要获得四个席位才能获得众议院多数席位，分析人士基本上预测他们会这样做。 共和党的失败将阻碍特朗普及其议程，因为民主党将能够阻止他的支出并进一步审查他的政策。 尽管如此，共和党领导人还是选择了一个简单的策略来赢得人心：更多而不是更少特朗普。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 但这一事件也伴随着巨大的政治风险：这位极不受欢迎的总统可能对脆弱的共和党候选人来说既是一种资产，又是一种负担。 此次大会旨在将特朗普的记录置于共和党竞选的中心。 特朗普计划这两天都出现在达拉斯美国航空中心，并在第一晚担任主角，然后于周四在副总统 JD 万斯发表主旨演讲后发表闭幕辞。 特朗普将这一活动宣传为庆祝他所称的政府的“巨大胜利”和共和党候选人。 众议院议长迈克·约翰逊告诉支持者，特朗普将直接向选民表明，虽然他的名字不会出现在 11 月的选票上，但他的政府和政治议程将会出现。 中期选举在总统任期过半时举行，通常多数党会被反对派夺走席位。 约翰逊在宣传这次集会的视频中表示：“我们确实有机会挑战历史并赢得中期选举。” 组织者希望展示减税和移民措施等政策，同时将民主党描绘得越来越极端。 一些共和党候选人不愿接受大会或许是该党面临困境的最明显迹象。 Politico 对 70 多名共和党政治家和候选人进行的一项调查发现，大多数人要么不打算参加，要么尚未承诺参加。还有数十人拒绝透露是否会参加。 一些脆弱的共和党人提到了竞选承诺、辩论或家庭义务。 据报道，其他人私下抱怨被要求捐款至少 25,000 美元（34,700 美元）才能参加。 大会的两个晚上都恰逢国家橄榄球联盟的揭幕战......

reflection.en: The gathering, dubbed "Trumpapalooza," is framed as an opportunity to celebrate past victories and secure future political success. However, the looming threat of electoral defeat suggests a potential fall from power, reminding us that pride often precedes such a downfall. The pursuit of political power, while a legitimate endeavor, carries the risk of...
reflection.zh: 这次被命名为“特朗普盛会”的集会被视为庆祝过往胜利和确保未来政治成功的机会。然而，迫在眉睫的选举失败威胁预示着权力可能旁落，这提醒我们骄傲往往是这种衰败的前兆。追求政治权力虽然是正当的努力，但却伴随着过度自信的风险，以及当现实未能达到野心时的后果。

verse.textEn: Pride goes before destruction, a haughty spirit before a fall.
verse.textZh: 骄傲在败坏以先；狂心在跌倒之前。

body.en:
Iran has threatened to retaliate against any new US attacks on its assets, warning that energy ‌infrastructure across the Gulf remains vulnerable.

"Strike our assets and you get struck," Iranian parliament speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf said after US and Iranian strikes on shipping at the weekend that pushed ‌oil prices up to near six-week highs on Monday.

The latest threat underscores the risks of further escalation, with no sign of progress towards a diplomatic breakthrough that could end more than six months ‌of conflict and restore normal energy flows through the Gulf.

Iran has tightened restrictions on shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, a critical artery for global oil and gas supplies, since the war began with US and Israeli strikes on 28 February.

On Sunday, senior Iranian security official Mohsen Rezaei said Tehran would soon announce a new restricted zone in the Gulf and unveil a shipping corridor through the strait.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Rezaei said the zone would begin where a US naval blockade of Iran starts and extend into parts of the Gulf. Any vessel entering the area would be placed on an Iranian sanctions list.

"We will only commit to the Strait of Hormuz being open ‌when (the Americans) stop the sabotage, ‌threats and attacks on Iran," Rezaei said.

Ghalibaf ⁠later reinforced Tehran's warning in what appeared to be a response to US Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, who had described Iran's oil tanker fleet as "defenceless".

"It's simple: the oil and gas production chain here is sprawling, accessible, and exposed. American oil and gas companies across these waters and facilities share that exposure," Ghalibaf, who is Iran's top negotiator, wrote on social media.

Regional tensions were heightened by Israeli strikes on a town in southern Lebanon that killed at least 12 people on Monday local time, according to Lebanon's health ministry, marking one of the deadliest days of bombardment in recent weeks.

The attacks have fuelled fears of a renewed Israeli military campaign despite a June ceasefire with the Hezbollah group.

They also complicate efforts to end the wider conflict, with Iran insisting that any lasting agreement with the US must include an ⁠end to Israeli attacks in Lebanon.

After a relative lull through much of August, hostilities have intensified again following the collapse of an interim ceasefire reached in June. Diplomatic efforts have made little headway .

On Saturday, US forces struck three Iranian oil tankers, including one near Kharg Island, Iran's main oil export hub, according to US Central Command.

body.zh: 伊朗威胁要对美国对其资产的任何新攻击进行报复，并警告称整个海湾地区的能源基础设施仍然脆弱。 伊朗议会议长穆罕默德·巴格尔·加利巴夫 (Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf) 在周末美国和伊朗对航运发动袭击后表示，“袭击我们的资产，你就会受到打击”，周一油价推升至接近六周高点。 最新的威胁凸显了局势进一步升级的风险，没有任何迹象表明在可能结束六个多月冲突并恢复海湾地区正常能源流动的外交突破方面取得进展。 自 2 月 28 日美国和以色列发动袭击以来，伊朗加强了对霍尔木兹海峡航运的限制，霍尔木兹海峡是全球石油和天然气供应的重要动脉。 周日，伊朗高级安全官员穆赫森·雷扎伊表示，德黑兰将很快宣布在海湾设立新的禁区，并推出一条穿过该海峡的航运走廊。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 雷扎伊表示，该区域将从美国对伊朗的海上封锁开始，并延伸到海湾部分地区。任何进入该地区的船只都将被列入伊朗制裁名单。 雷扎伊说：“只有当（美国人）停止对伊朗的破坏、威胁和攻击时，我们才会承诺开放霍尔木兹海峡。” 加利巴夫后来强化了德黑兰的警告，这似乎是对美国国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯的回应，后者称伊朗的油轮舰队“毫无防御能力”。 伊朗最高谈判代表加利巴夫在社交媒体上写道：“很简单：这里的石油和天然气生产链庞大、容易进入且暴露。这些水域和设施上的美国石油和天然气公司也面临着同样的风险。” 据黎巴嫩卫生部称，以色列当地时间周一对黎巴嫩南部一座城镇的袭击造成至少 12 人死亡，这也是近几周来伤亡最惨重的轰炸事件之一，这加剧了地区紧张局势。 尽管六月与真主党达成停火，但这些袭击加剧了人们对以色列重新发动军事行动的担忧。 它们还使结束更广泛冲突的努力变得复杂，伊朗坚持认为与美国达成的任何持久协议都必须包括结束以色列对黎巴嫩的袭击。 经过八月大部分时间的相对平静后，随着六月达成的临时停火协议破裂，敌对行动再次加剧。外交努力几乎没有取得什么进展。 据美国中央司令部称，周六，美军袭击了三艘伊朗油轮，其中一艘靠近伊朗主要石油出口中心哈格岛。 这些袭击是在伊朗发动袭击之后发生的。

reflection.en: The cycle of threat and counter-threat between Iran and the US over energy assets in the Gulf risks further escalation. This pattern of responding to aggression with aggression, as described by Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf, can trap nations in a destructive spiral. The call to 'overcome evil with good' offers a different path, one that seeks to break the cycle...
reflection.zh: 伊朗与美国之间在海湾能源资产问题上的威胁与反威胁循环，有进一步升级的风险。正如穆罕默德·巴盖尔·加利巴夫所描述的，以侵略回应侵略的模式，会将国家困在破坏性的螺旋中。“以善胜恶”的呼吁提供了一条不同的道路，即寻求打破循环而非延续它，即使面对挑衅。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
title.zh: 巴勒斯坦父母担心定居者袭击加剧，危及孩子们的生命

summary.en: A headteacher in the occupied West Bank has installed new barbed wire fencing after three pupils were killed this year.
summary.zh: 在约旦河西岸的一位校长在今年有三名学生丧生后，安装了新的铁丝网围栏。

body.en:
On the first day of the new Palestinian school year, the head-teacher of al-Mughayyir boys school arrived at work before dawn, walking past the freshly installed barbed wire fencing and reinforced school gates as the sun began creeping through olive trees around the village, deep inside the occupied West Bank.

"We are scared," Bassam al Assaf told me. "The students are afraid, and their parents are afraid."

Six people, including three pupils at the school, have been killed in al-Mughayyir this year, in a surge of settler-related violence against Palestinians. One of them, 14-year-old Aws al-Naasan, was shot dead by a settler outside the school gates in April.

"I was inside my classroom and two little students came rushing to tell me there were settlers close to the school wall," remembers English teacher Waheed Abu Naem, whose brother Jihad was also killed by an Israeli soldier in the same attack.

Waheed said he was trying to move pupils to safety inside the school gate when the settler fired towards them. Mobile phone footage shows the moment Aws was shot.

"When I turned him onto his back, I saw lots of blood coming from his nose and mouth, and the bullet in his head," said Waheed. "We lost him."

He told me that bullets continued hitting the school building, as students hid behind the walls of their classrooms, or lay on the floor.

The Israeli military said in a statement at the time that stones had been hurled at a car carrying "civilians including a reservist soldier", and that the reservist had got out of the vehicle and fired at suspects.

Israeli media reported the reservist was later suspended from duty and an investigation launched.

Over the summer, two more pupils were shot dead by Israeli forces during settler attacks and incursions in the village, along with a 19-year-old who had just left the school.

In both cases, Israel's army said its forces responded to instigators of "a violent riot".

With three empty desks in the classrooms, some parents were reluctant to send their children back for the new school year.

The school sits right on the edge of Al-Mughayyir, an isolated village north-east of Ramallah, increasingly surrounded by Jewish settler outposts, and regularly blocked by Israeli forces who frequently operate an ad-hoc checkpoint at the entrance.

Bassam al-Assaf has installed a long barbed-wire fence around the compound and reinforced the school gates, to try and reassure parents. Ambulance crews are now stationed on the road outside, and several parents have volunteered to wait outside the school all day as an extra layer of protection.

"I came because it makes the children feel their parents are with them, that they are safe, it gives them a kind of security," said Haroon Bishara, whose boys are in the first and...
body.zh: 巴勒斯坦新学年的第一天，穆盖伊尔男子学校的校长在黎明前到达工作岗位，走过新安装的铁丝网和加固的校门，阳光开始穿过被占领的约旦河西岸深处村庄周围的橄榄树。 “我们很害怕，”巴萨姆·阿萨夫告诉我。 “学生害怕，家长也害怕。” 今年，穆加耶尔发生了与定居者相关的针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力事件，造成六人死亡，其中包括该校的三名学生。其中一名 14 岁的 Aws al-Naasan 于 4 月在学校门外被一名定居者枪杀。 “我在教室里，两个小学生冲过来告诉我，学校围墙附近有定居者，”英语老师瓦希德·阿布·纳姆 (Waheed Abu Naem) 回忆道，他的兄弟吉哈德也在同一次袭击中被一名以色列士兵杀害。 瓦希德说，当定居者向他们开枪时，他正试图将学生转移到校门内的安全地带。手机录像显示了 Aws 被枪杀的那一刻。 瓦希德说：“当我把他翻过来时，我看到他的鼻子和嘴巴流了很多血，子弹射中了他的头部。” “我们失去了他。” 他告诉我，子弹继续击中教学楼，学生们躲在教室的墙后面，或者躺在地板上。 以色列军方当时在一份声明中表示，有人向一辆载有“包括一名预备役军人在内的平民”的汽车投掷石块，预备役军人下了车并向嫌疑人开枪。 以色列媒体报道称，这名预备役军人后来被停职并展开调查。 今年夏天，定居者袭击和入侵村庄期间，又有两名学生和一名刚刚离开学校的 19 岁学生被以色列军队枪杀。 在这两起事件中，以色列军队均表示其部队对“暴力骚乱”的煽动者做出了回应。 由于教室里空了三张课桌，一些家长不愿意送孩子回去过新学年。 学校坐落在拉马拉东北部的一个偏僻村庄穆盖耶尔的边缘，周围越来越多的犹太定居者前哨基地，并且经常遭到以色列军队的封锁，以色列军队经常在入口处设置临时检查站。 巴萨姆·阿萨夫在校园周围安装了长长的铁丝网，并加固了学校大门，试图让家长放心。救护人员现已驻扎在校外的道路上，一些家长自愿在学校外等候一整天，以提供额外的保护。 “我来是因为这让孩子们感到父母和他们在一起，他们很安全，这给了他们一种安全感，”哈龙·比沙拉说，他的男孩们都在第一和……

reflection.en: The installation of barbed wire and reinforced gates at al-Mughayyir boys school speaks to a desperate need for protection. The fear of parents and children underscores the vulnerability of the young in a climate of violence, echoing the ancient call to defend the oppressed and seek justice for those who cannot protect themselves. May Yahweh grant wisdom...
reflection.zh: 在穆盖伊尔男子学校安装铁丝网和加固的门，体现了对保护的绝望需求。父母和孩子们的恐惧，凸显了在暴力环境中儿童的脆弱性，这呼应了古老的呼吁：要保护受压迫者，为那些无法保护自己的人寻求正义。 愿雅伟赐予保护弱者者的智慧和勇气，并愿祂使施暴者的心转向和平与公义。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

body.en: New York City mayor confirms he will attend memorial service but declines to respond to Giuliani’s remarks New York mayor Zohran Mamdani is set to come face-to-face with Rudy Giuliani at the main September 11 memorial service, just days after the former mayor – who led the city at the time of the 2001 terrorist attacks – disparaged his Muslim religion and said he should skip the ceremony. In an interview with right-leaning Newsmax at the weekend, Giuliani said : “Having lost friends there and being very close to many of the families, it offends me that he’s coming.” Continue reading...

reflection.en: As the city prepares to commemorate the profound loss of 9/11, former Mayor Giuliani has chosen to escalate division by attacking Mayor Mamdani’s faith. This response, rooted in personal offense rather than shared grief, risks perpetuating cycles of animosity. The call to overcome evil with good, rather than mirroring it, remains a vital challenge,...
reflection.zh: 当纽约市准备纪念九一一的巨大损失时，前市长朱利安尼选择通过攻击市长马姆达尼的信仰来加剧分裂。这种回应植根于个人冒犯而非共同的悲伤，有加剧敌对循环的风险。在原本应是团结和纪念的时刻，以善胜恶而非以恶报恶的呼吁，仍然是一个重要的挑战。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

A coalition of groups, comprising veteran lawyers, voting specialists, and former judges, has intensified legal challenges against Donald Trump's authoritarian executive orders concerning...
summary.zh: 倡导团体正在扩大法律挑战，并谴责总统“为了一己私利而试图掌控中期选举”。一个由资深律师、投票专家和前法官组成的倡导团体联盟，已加强了对唐纳德·特朗普关于投票和其他总统行为的威权主义行政命令的法律挑战，他们认为这些命令是对美国法治的“战争”。民主捍卫者基金会、竞选法律中心和美国公民自由联盟等组织已对特朗普关于限制投票权和...

body.en: Advocacy groups expand legal challenges and condemn president’s ‘self-serving attempts to take over midterms’ A cluster of advocacy groups that boast veteran lawyers, voting experts and ex-judges have expanded legal challenges to Donald Trump’s authoritarian executive orders on voting and other presidential actions they see as a “war” on the rule of law in the US. Heavy legal opposition to Trump’s two executive orders on elections to curb voting rights and supplant the authority of states on election matters has come from the Democracy Defenders Fund, the Campaign Legal Center, the American Civil Liberties Union and kindred groups. This article was updated on 7 September 2026 to reflect that members of the Democratic Attorneys General Association have filed suit, not the Daga itself. Continue reading...
body.zh: 倡导团体扩大法律挑战并谴责总统“接管中期选举的自私企图”一群拥有资深律师、投票专家和前法官的倡导团体扩大了对唐纳德·特朗普关于投票和其他总统行动的独裁行政命令的法律挑战，他们认为这是对美国法治的“战争”。特朗普关于选举的两项行政命令旨在限制投票权并取代各州在选举事务上的权威，法律上的强烈反对来自民主捍卫者基金会、竞选法律中心、美国公民自由联盟和类似团体。本文于 2026 年 9 月 7 日更新，以反映提起诉讼的是民主党总检察长协会成员，而不是 Daga 本身。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the United States, advocacy groups are leveraging legal expertise to challenge executive actions they deem an "assault on democracy." This struggle highlights the ongoing tension between executive power and the rule of law, a dynamic that Proverbs 29:2 addresses by contrasting the stability brought by righteous rulers with the chaos caused by the wicked.
reflection.zh: 在美国，倡导团体正利用法律专业知识挑战他们认为是对“民主的攻击”的行政命令。这场斗争凸显了行政权与法治之间持续存在的紧张关系，而《箴言》29:2 恰恰通过对比公正统治者带来的稳定与恶人造成的混乱，来阐述了这种动态。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

Around 60 foreign carriers still operate scheduled services to Russian...

body.en:
Russian airspace has been closed to Australian, European and North American airlines for more than four years, but it has not been empty.

Around 60 foreign carriers still operate scheduled services to Russian airports, and a larger number cross the country without landing, taking the shortest route between Europe and Asia while Western competitors detour south.

Last week, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told all of them to reconsider, warning that "Russian airspace is becoming completely unsafe" as Ukraine expands its long-range drone campaign.

Passengers from Australian airports cannot fly to Russia directly, and Qantas has avoided the airspace since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. But those connecting through China's Guangzhou or Shanghai airports, or India's Delhi airport, may still spend part of their journey over Russian territory because the carriers operating those sectors retain access.

An independent Russian outlet reported that 27 foreign airlines cancelled flights to Moscow within a day of Zelenskyy's warning. Several of those carriers offered explanations that did not reference the Ukrainian president's announcement, while others were still overflying as normal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The airlines with access to airspace come almost entirely from countries that have not sanctioned Russia.

Russia closed its own skies in 2022 to more than 35 countries and territories, a list that included all 27 European Union member states, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Australia, and New Zealand.

Chinese carriers form the largest group still flying. Air China, China Eastern, China Southern, Hainan Airlines, Xiamen Air and Beijing Capital Airlines all use Russian airspace, principally to reach western Europe.

British Airways' London–Beijing service is around 1,600km longer than its Chinese competitors' equivalent, adding almost two hours.

Gulf carriers have become Russia's main link to the wider world. Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways and flydubai all serve Russian cities, connecting Moscow and St Petersburg to hundreds of destinations — including Australia — through their hubs.

Emirates flies to Moscow and routes its Dubai–US West Coast services along a polar track over northern Russia. Air India operates no Russian services but crosses the country on every flight to the US and Canada.

title.en: 3 years on, Morocco earthquake victims still wait for help
title.zh: 三年后，摩洛哥地震幸存者仍在等待援助

summary.en: Three years after the 2023 Morocco earthquake, which killed nearly 3,000 people and devastated the Al Haouz region, some survivors are still living in tents. While reconstruction has progressed, local opinions are divided on the success and adequacy of state aid.
summary.zh: 2023年摩洛哥地震发生三年后，这场地震造成近3000人死亡，并摧毁了阿尔豪兹地区，但一些幸存者仍然住在帐篷里。虽然重建工作已经取得进展，但当地居民对援助的成功程度和国家援助的充分性意见不一。

body.en:
Reconstruction has progressed in the three years since the 2023 Morocco earthquake, but some survivors are still living in tents. Locals are divided as to how successful it's been, and whether state aid is enough.

On September 8, 2023, a devastating earthquake struck the Al Haouz region in Morocco , killing over 2,900 people, injuring more than 5,500  and causing widespread destruction.

In the village of Ighermane in the High Atlas Mountains, about 50 kilometers (30 miles) southwest of Marrakech, Mohamed Ait Belaid, 72, feels like things are actually going pretty well for him three years later.

He had been living in a tent after the earthquake  but now resides in a newly built house, even though it's smaller than the one destroyed in the earthquake.

"I benefited from partial [state] support and received 80,000 dirhams [around €7,300] for rebuilding," he told DW. "I added about 100,000 [€9,110] dirhams from my own pocket. And thanks to God, I like my new house and I'm comfortable in it. I'm at peace because my wife, my children and I are all healthy and I haven't lost any of them."

Around 40 kilometers away, in the town of Azgour, it's a different story. Larbi Ait Jelloulat, also 72, is sitting in front of a pile of rubble that was once his house.

"I want to know where my rights have gone," he said angrily. "Who took what's rightfully mine? For three years, I've been going from one department to another, from one complaint to another, from one petition to another, just looking for an answer. Why have I been excluded? Am I not a Moroccan citizen?"

Ait Jelloulat was formerly a council employee and saved for years in order to build the large home that was destroyed in the 2023 earthquake. As far as he can tell, bureaucratic issues mean he must prove he was a resident in the area.

"My only dream was to spend the rest of my life in my own home, a rest after years of service," he explained. "Now they say I'm not a resident … Where's the logic in that?"

Reconstruction seems to be happening faster in Ighermane, the village where Ait Belaid lives. About 90% of the village is rebuilt and most residents' lives are back to normal , said Omar Saeed from the Ighermane Association for Development and Solidarity.

Of the village's around 150 families, 114 received state support of some kind, although most also had to contribute some of their own money to rebuild.

Meanwhile, in Azgour, where Ait Jelloulat lives, there's been more to do. Azgour was the village most impacted by the earthquake in the area.

There, about 76 families have had help with reconstruction, Ait Jelloulat said, while 56 others are still waiting for help. "What's more, the 76 families who rebuilt their homes in a different location are also having problems connecting...
body.zh: 自2023年摩洛哥地震以来的三年里，重建工作不断取得进展，但一些幸存者仍然住在帐篷里。当地人对于它的成功程度以及国家援助是否足够存在分歧。 2023 年 9 月 8 日，摩洛哥豪兹地区发生毁灭性地震，造成 2,900 多人死亡、5,500 多人受伤，并造成大面积破坏。 在马拉喀什西南约 50 公里（30 英里）处的高阿特拉斯山脉的伊格曼村，72 岁的穆罕默德·艾特·贝莱德 (Mohamed Ait Belaid) 感觉三年后他的生活实际上进展顺利。 地震后他一直住在帐篷里，但现在住在一栋新建的房子里，尽管它比地震中被毁的房子小。 “我受益于部分[国家]支持，并收到了80,000迪拉姆[约7,300欧元]用于重建，”他告诉德国之声。 “我从自己的口袋里添加了大约 100,000 [€9,110] 迪拉姆。感谢上帝，我喜欢我的新房子，而且我在里面很舒服。我很平静，因为我的妻子、孩子和我都很健康，我没有失去任何一个。” 大约 40 公里外的阿兹古尔镇却是另一番景象。 同样 72 岁的拉尔比·艾特·杰鲁拉特 (Larbi Ait Jelloulat) 坐在一堆瓦砾前，这里曾经是他的房子。 “我想知道我的权利去了哪里，”他愤怒地说。 “谁拿走了我应得的东西？三年来，我从一个部门到另一个部门，从一份投诉到另一份投诉，从一份请愿书到另一份请愿书，只是在寻找答案。为什么我被排除在外？我不是摩洛哥公民吗？” 艾特·杰卢拉特 (Ait Jelloulat) 以前是一名市议会雇员，为了建造在 2023 年地震中被毁的大房子，他存了多年的钱。据他所知，官僚问题意味着他必须证明自己是该地区的居民。 “我唯一的梦想是在自己的家里度过余生，在服役多年后得到休息，”他解释道。 “现在他们说我不是居民……这有什么逻辑吗？” 艾特·贝莱德 (Ait Belaid) 居住的村庄伊格曼 (Ighermane) 的重建似乎进展得更快。伊格曼发展与团结协会的奥马尔·赛义德表示，该村庄约 90% 的面积已得到重建，大多数居民的生活已恢复正常。 该村约有 150 个家庭，其中 114 个家庭得到了某种形式的国家支持，不过大多数家庭还必须自掏腰包进行重建。 与此同时，在艾特·杰鲁拉特 (Ait Jellolat) 居住的阿兹古尔 (Azgour)，还有更多事情要做。阿兹古尔是该地区受地震影响最严重的村庄。 Ait Jelloulat 说，在那里，大约 76 个家庭获得了重建帮助，而其他 56 个家庭仍在等待帮助。 “此外，在不同地点重建家园的 76 个家庭也遇到了连接问题......

reflection.en: The earthquake in Morocco in 2023 brought immense suffering, and even after three years, the journey of recovery is ongoing for many. The image of survivors still living in tents is a stark reminder that the work of rebuilding lives and communities requires sustained compassion and action. We are called to advocate for those whose needs persist, ensuring...
reflection.zh: 2023年摩洛哥地震带来了巨大的痛苦，即使在三年后，许多人的康复之路仍在继续。幸存者仍然住在帐篷里的景象， starkly提醒我们，重建生活和社区的工作需要持续的怜悯和行动。我们被呼召为那些需求持续存在的人们发声，确保他们不被遗忘。

verse.textEn: Learn to do right; seek justice. Defend the oppressed. Take up the cause of the fatherless; plead the case of the widow.
verse.textZh: 学习行善，寻求公平，解救受欺压的；给孤儿伸冤，为寡妇辨屈。

title.en: Nicaragua challenges German arms exports to Israel at ICJ
title.zh: 尼加拉瓜就德国向以色列出口武器一事在海牙国际法院提起诉讼

summary.en: Nicaragua has accused Germany of violating the Genocide Convention by supplying arms to Israel and has asked the International Court of Justice (ICJ) to take up the case. Germany has requested the ICJ dismiss the case on jurisdictional grounds, stating its arms exports are documented, published, and subject to...
summary.zh: 尼加拉瓜指控德国违反《灭绝种族公约》，向以色列供应武器，并已请求国际法院（ICJ）受理此案。德国则要求国际法院以管辖权为由驳回此案，并表示其武器出口均有记录、已公开且受到严格审查。

body.zh: 德国已请求国际法院以管辖权为由驳回此案。它还表示，其向以色列的武器出口是有记录、公开的，并且受到比大多数国家更严格的检查。 德国周一要求国际法院驳回尼加拉瓜提起的诉讼，指控柏林在加沙与哈马斯的战争中向以色列提供武器，违反了 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》。 如果国际法院（也称为世界法院）决定审理此案，整个过程可能需要数年时间，并且取决于海牙单独的加沙相关案件的调查结果。 但德国辩称，它甚至不应该走那么远，称尼加拉瓜没有遵循适当的程序，而且该争端不属于国际法院的管辖范围。 另一方面，尼加拉瓜认为应该审理此案，因为它和德国都是《种族灭绝公约》的签署国——尽管双方都没有直接参与以色列和哈马斯在加沙的战争，而且国际法院关于以色列是否在加沙实施种族灭绝行为的听证会可能需要数年时间。 尼加拉瓜指责德国向以色列出售武器，协助和教唆加沙种族灭绝，并称其中一些武器已在加沙使用。 2024 年加沙战争最激烈时，最初申请紧急禁令停止出口的努力失败了，但德国也未能尽早立即永久驳回此案。 由于冲突持续且伤亡数字上升，德国政府于 2025 年暂停向以色列出口武器约三个月。但自去年年底达成休战以来，以色列又重新启动了这些行动，该休战基本上停止了战斗，但以色列的袭击并未完全结束。 一方面，1948 年《种族灭绝公约》在很大程度上是从大屠杀的教训和二战后“不再发生”的精神中诞生的。但出于同样的原因，德国始终寻求与以色列保持密切的合作关系，以色列的国家在很大程度上是由于大规模灭绝欧洲犹太人而形成的。它认为以色列的安全是其作为现代民主国家存在的理由的一部分。 哈马斯于 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列发动恐怖袭击后，以色列在加沙发动了针对哈马斯的战争。 10 月 7 日是自大屠杀以来犹太人死亡人数最多的一天。哈马斯是一个总部位于加沙地带的巴勒斯坦伊斯兰组织。 德国辩称，该案应根据程序理由驳回，而尼加拉瓜关于协助和教唆种族灭绝的指控没有事实根据。 尽管德国、尼加拉瓜和以色列都...

reflection.en: The news of Nicaragua challenging Germany at the International Court of Justice over arms exports to Israel highlights the complex global dynamics of conflict and accountability. In times of war, the world often looks for divine intervention to cease hostilities and dismantle instruments of destruction. Psalm 46:9 speaks to this hope, envisioning a future...
reflection.zh: 尼加拉瓜就德国向以色列出口武器一事在国际法院提起诉讼的消息，凸显了冲突与问责在全球范围内的复杂动态。在战争时期，世界常常寻求神圣的干预来停止敌对行动并拆除毁灭的工具。《诗篇》46:9 呼应了这一希望，描绘了一个武器被废弃、和平得以实现的未来。

title.en: Tanzanian President Samia's husband dies in hospital
title.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统哈桑的丈夫在医院去世

summary.en: Hafidh Ameir Hassan, the husband of Tanzanian President Samia Suluhu Hassan, has passed away while receiving medical treatment in Zanzibar. He was an agricultural academic who maintained a low public profile and became Tanzania's first First Gentleman in 2021. He was reportedly suffering from a heart condition and was...
summary.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统萨米亚·苏卢胡·哈桑的丈夫哈菲兹·阿米尔·哈桑在桑给巴尔一家医院接受治疗期间去世。他是一位农业学者，公众形象低调，于2021年成为坦桑尼亚第一位第一先生。据报道，他患有心脏病，并于周一晚间下葬。

body.en:
The husband of Tanzania's President Samia Suluhu Hassan, Hafidh Ameir Hassan, has died while receiving treatment at a hospital in Zanzibar.

Vice-president Deogratius Ndejembi - who made the official announcement of Ameir's death - said he had been suffering from a heart condition.

He was buried at his family's residence in Kizimkazi, a village on the country's semi-autonomous island of Zanzibar, on Monday evening.

Ameir was an agricultural academic who largely kept a low public profile. He became Tanzania's first First Gentleman after President Samia took office in 2021.

In his announcement, Ndejembi said Ameir died at 08:00 local time (06:00 GMT) on Monday at the Emilio Mzena Memorial Hospital.

The vice-president led tributes as he conveyed his condolences to Samia, as well as Ameir's family and friends.

Kenyan President William Ruto said he received the news of his passing with "deep sorrow".

"President Samia has lost a lifelong companion, her children a beloved father, and Tanzania a distinguished son," he wrote on social media.

Zambia's President Hakainde Hichilema also shared his condolences, saying that they "stand side by side" with the first family, and all of Tanzania during "this difficult time".

Similarly, Burundi's President Évariste Ndayishimiye paid his respects and prayed for Samia and her family to have "comfort and strength in this difficult moment".

The First Gentleman rarely appeared in public alongside the president. He was only occasionally seen with her at official events.

He married Samia in 1978, before she entered national politics. The couple had four children - three sons and a daughter - together.

Their daughter, Wanu Hafidh Ameir, is also a politician who currently serves in Zanzibar's House of Representatives in the National Assembly.
body.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统萨米亚·苏鲁胡·哈桑的丈夫哈菲德·阿米尔·哈桑在桑给巴尔一家医院接受治疗时去世。 正式宣布阿米尔去世的副总统德奥格拉修斯·恩德杰姆比 (Deogratius Ndejembi) 表示，阿米尔一直患有心脏病。 周一晚上，他被埋葬在该国半自治桑给巴尔岛基济姆卡济村的家人住所。 阿米尔是一位农业学者，在公众面前一直保持低调。 2021年萨米亚总统就职后，他成为坦桑尼亚第一位第一绅士。 恩德杰姆比在声明中表示，阿梅尔于周一当地时间 08:00（格林尼治标准时间 06:00）在埃米利奥·姆泽纳纪念医院去世。 副总统向萨米亚以及阿米尔的家人和朋友表示哀悼。 肯尼亚总统威廉·鲁托表示，他收到他去世的消息“深感悲痛”。 他在社交媒体上写道：“萨米亚总统失去了一位终生伴侣，她的孩子们失去了一位亲爱的父亲，坦桑尼亚失去了一位杰出的儿子。” 赞比亚总统哈凯恩德·希奇莱马也表达了哀悼，并表示在“这个困难时期”，他们与第一家庭以及整个坦桑尼亚“并肩作战”。 同样，布隆迪总统埃瓦里斯特·恩达伊什米耶也表达了敬意，并祈祷萨米亚及其家人“在这个困难时刻获得安慰和力量”。 第一先生很少与总统一起出现在公共场合。他只是偶尔在官方活动中与她在一起。 1978 年，在萨米亚进入国家政坛之前，他与她结婚。这对夫妇有四个孩子——三个儿子和一个女儿。 他们的女儿瓦努·哈菲德·阿米尔 (Wanu Hafidh Ameir) 也是一名政治家，目前在桑给巴尔国民议会众议院任职。

reflection.en: The news of Hafidh Ameir Hassan's passing reminds us of the universal reality of mortality. Hebrews 9:27 speaks to this truth, stating that death is appointed for all people. In moments of loss, especially for public figures, we are called to reflect on our shared human condition and the brevity of life.
reflection.zh: 坦桑尼亚总统哈桑的丈夫哈菲兹·阿米尔·哈桑去世的消息，提醒我们死亡是全人类的共同命运。希伯来书9章27节指出了这一真理，即人人都有一死。在失去亲人的时刻，尤其是对于公众人物，我们被呼召反思我们共同的人性以及生命的短暂。

verse.textEn: Just as people are destined to die once, and after that to face judgment.
verse.textZh: 按着定命，人人都有一死，死后且有审判。

title.en: Indonesia volcano eruption leaves 340,000 stranded as airports extend closure
title.zh: 印度尼西亚火山爆发致34万人滞留，机场延长关闭

summary.en: Anak Krakatau volcano, located about 150km from the capital Jakarta, began spewing lava and volcanic ash late on Friday, causing nearly 3,000 flights to be disrupted and leaving over 340,000 passengers stranded across Indonesia as airports extended their closures.
summary.zh: 位于雅加达以南约150公里的喀拉喀托之子火山（Anak Krakatau）于周五晚间开始喷发熔岩和火山灰，导致印度尼西亚全国近3000个航班中断，超过34万名乘客滞留，机场也因此延长了关闭时间。

body.en:
More than 340,000 passengers have been left stranded across Indonesia after a volcanic eruption disrupted nearly 3,000 flights and forced airports to suspend operations for a second day.

Anak Krakatau, located 150km (90mi) from Jakarta, began erupting late on Friday, producing lava fountains and sending volcanic ash into the capital and the Lampung province. It stayed seismically active throughout the weekend.

Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International airport decided not to reopen at 18:00 (11:00 GMT) as planned due to the continued presence of volcanic ash near its airspace.

Flights will instead resume at 23:59 on Monday, the airport has said in a statement.

Halim Perdanakusuma, a smaller airport that caters to civil and military flights, will also remain closed until then.

Snaking queues formed at the departure halls in Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport on Monday as stranded passengers sought refunds and tried to get updates on when they would be able to fly.

Finna, who was supposed to fly home to Jakarta from Malang, a city in East Java, on Sunday morning, described the frezny at the airport as flights got repeatedly rescheduled.

"It was very crowded because passengers from the morning flights had piled up, while those scheduled for later departures still didn't know what would happen," the 46-year-old told BBC Indonesian.

Not wanting to deal with the uncertainty, Finna eventually spent the night on two intercity trains before arriving in Jakarta at 03:00 on Monday.

"Everyone seems to be racking their brains [figuring alternative transportation options]", said Jo Shaw, who was visiting Indonesia with members of her conservation charity Save the Rhino International.

Shaw's team had axed their plans to camp out at Java's Ujung Kulon National Park after authorities raised its alert level for the Anak Krakatau volcano.

"Being stranded in an airport hotel is a relatively minor inconvenience to be resolved in a few days hopefully," Shaw said, adding that she was more concerned about the teams working on the ground with the rhinos under such environmental conditions.

A newly wed Malaysian couple who had just spent a week in Bali said they were told that the next flight back to Kuala Lumpur wouldn't be until 11 September.

"What are we going to do here for another five days? We only prepared enough money for our honeymoon and [were supposed] to go home yesterday," Amir Hamzah told Malaysia's national news agency Bernama.

"We thought we would just sleep at the airport for a few hours and then take the morning flight home [on Monday]. We never thought we would end up being stuck here for days," the 29-year-old said.

On Monday, Indonesia's Geological Agency warned that "the probability of further eruptions in the coming periods...
body.zh: 火山喷发导致近 3,000 个航班中断，并迫使机场连续第二天暂停运营，导致超过 340,000 名乘客滞留在印度尼西亚各地。 距离雅加达 150 公里（90 英里）的阿纳克喀拉喀托火山于周五晚些时候开始喷发，产生熔岩喷泉，并将火山灰输送到首都和楠榜省。整个周末它都处于地震活跃状态。 由于空域附近持续存在火山灰，雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场决定不按计划于 18:00（格林威治标准时间 11:00）重新开放。 机场在一份声明中表示，航班将于周一 23:59 恢复。 Halim Perdanakusuma 是一个较小的机场，可满足民用和军用航班的需求，在此之前也将保持关闭。 周一，雅加达苏加诺-哈达国际机场的出发大厅排起了蜿蜒的队伍，滞留的乘客寻求退款，并试图了解何时可以起飞的最新消息。 芬纳本应于周日早上从东爪哇城市玛琅飞往雅加达的家中，她描述了由于航班多次重新安排而导致机场出现的混乱情况。 这位 46 岁的乘客告诉 BBC 印尼语：“机场非常拥挤，因为早班航班的乘客已经堆积如山，而那些计划稍后起飞的乘客仍然不知道会发生什么。” 由于不想应对这种不确定性，Finna 最终在两趟城际列车上过夜，然后于周一 03:00 抵达雅加达。 “每个人似乎都在绞尽脑汁（考虑替代交通选择）”，乔·肖（Jo Shaw）说，她正在与她的保护慈善机构“拯救犀牛国际”的成员一起访问印度尼西亚。 在当局提高了阿纳克喀拉喀托火山的警戒级别后，肖的团队取消了在爪哇乌戎库隆国家公园露营的计划。 肖说：“被困在机场酒店是一个相对较小的不便，希望几天内就能解决。”她补充说，她更担心在这种环境条件下在地面与犀牛一起工作的团队。 一对刚刚在巴厘岛度过一周的马来西亚新婚夫妇表示，他们被告知下一班返回吉隆坡的航班要到 9 月 11 日才会起飞。 阿米尔·哈姆扎 (Amir Hamzah) 告诉马来西亚国家通讯社马新社：“接下来的五天我们要在这里做什么？我们只为蜜月准备了足够的钱，[本来]应该在昨天回家。” “我们以为我们会在机场睡几个小时，然后（周一）搭乘早班飞机回家。我们没想到我们最终会被困在这里好几天，”这位 29 岁的年轻人说。 周一，印度尼西亚地质机构警告称，“未来一段时间内可能会进一步喷发......

reflection.en: The eruption of Anak Krakatau has created a sudden crisis, leaving hundreds of thousands stranded and disrupting daily life. In times of natural disaster, when the earth itself seems to tremble, we can find solace in the knowledge that Yahweh is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. This ancient truth offers comfort amidst the chaos and...
reflection.zh: 喀拉喀托之子火山的喷发造成了一场突如其来的危机，使数十万人滞留，扰乱了日常生活。在自然灾害面前，当大地似乎都在震动时，我们可以从雅伟是我们避难所和力量、是患难中随时的帮助这一事实中找到慰藉。这古老的真理在这些事件带来的混乱和不确定性中提供了安慰。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
title.zh: Grindr将支付2600万英镑以解决其涉嫌共享用户艾滋病毒状况的指控

summary.en: The long-running claim alleges Grindr breached UK privacy laws by sharing data with third parties. Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information, including their HIV status, with third parties. The class action suit, which began in 2024, involved over 11,000...
summary.zh: 一项长期存在的诉讼指控Grindr违反英国隐私法，与第三方共享数据。Grindr已同意支付2600万英镑以了结一项诉讼，该诉讼指控其与第三方共享用户个人信息，包括其艾滋病毒状况。该集体诉讼于2024年提起，涉及超过11,000名原告。

body.en:
Grindr has agreed to pay £26m to settle a lawsuit over allegations it shared users' personal information - including their HIV status - with third parties.

The world's largest LGBTQ+ dating app was sued in the High Court in 2024 over claims it misused people's personal information.

The class action suit was later served in the US, with the law firm leading the case saying it had signed up more than 11,000 claimants.

According to a US regulatory filing, Grindr will make two £13m payments to settle the claims. The firm said the settlement includes no admission of liability.

Grindr stressed the claims relate to "historical data practices" before 2020 when it was owned by Chinese firm Kunlun.

The filing submitted to the US Securities and Exchange Commission , external by Grindr said a settlement had been reached on 2 September.

"While Grindr disputes the allegations, it recognizes and acknowledges the distress and loss of trust expressed by some of its UK users regarding that pre-2020 period," the company said in its filing.

The firm has agreed to pay £13m to the counterparties by 31 December and a further £13m by 31 March 2027.

The claims brought more than two years ago by law firm Austen Hayes alleged Grindr had shared sensitive data with third parties for commercial purposes, breaching UK privacy laws.

It said this included information about the ethnicity and sexual orientation of its users.

People on Grindr have the option to share their HIV status along with when they were last tested - a move it says aims to reduce stigma, facilitate conversations and help users make informed health choices.

Chaya Hanoomanjee, the lawyer who led the claim, said in April 2024 claimants had "experienced significant distress" over their sensitive and private information being shared without their consent.

She said the company "owes it to the LGBTQ+ community it serves to compensate those whose data has been compromised".

Two data analytics services, Apptimize and Localytics, were identified as third parties with access to the sensitive data.

The claim said a potentially unlimited number of third parties used it to customise advertisements to Grindr's users.

It followed revelations in 2018 that Grindr had been sharing personal data, including the HIV status of its users, with the two data analytics providers.

Grindr defended the practice at the time as in line with industry standards – but it said it then stopped sharing HIV data with those companies.

It was fined £5.5m by Norway's data protection watchdog and, later in 2022, reprimanded by the UK Information Commissioner's Office for its data practices.

The company said in its filing on Friday that since 2020, it had "overhauled" its privacy practices to help meet the "unique needs of its...
body.zh: Grindr 已同意支付 2600 万英镑，以了结一项针对其与第三方共享用户个人信息（包括其艾滋病毒状况）的诉讼。 全球最大的 LGBTQ+ 约会应用程序于 2024 年在高等法院被起诉，指控其滥用人们的个人信息。 该集体诉讼后来在美国送达，牵头该案的律​​师事务所表示，已与 11,000 多名索赔人签署了协议。 根据美国监管机构提交的文件，Grindr 将支付两笔 1300 万英镑的款项来和解索赔。该公司表示，和解协议不包括承认责任。 Grindr 强调，这些说法与 2020 年之前的“历史数据实践”有关，当时它属于中国公司昆仑万维。 Grindr 向美国证券交易委员会提交的外部文件称，已于 9 月 2 日达成和解。 该公司在文件中表示：“虽然 Grindr 对这些指控提出异议，但它承认并承认一些英国用户对 2020 年之前的这段时期所表达的痛苦和失去信任。” 该公司已同意在 12 月 31 日之前向交易对手支付 1300 万英镑，并在 2027 年 3 月 31 日之前再支付 1300 万英镑。 两年多前，Austen Hayes 律师事务所提出指控，称 Grindr 出于商业目的与第三方共享敏感数据，违反了英国隐私法。 该公司表示，这包括有关其用户的种族和性取向的信息。 Grindr 上的人们可以选择分享他们的艾滋病毒状况以及最后一次检测的时间——据称此举旨在减少耻辱、促进对话并帮助用户做出明智的健康选择。 主导索赔的律师查亚·哈努曼吉 (Chaya Hanoomanjee) 于 2024 年 4 月表示，索赔人因未经本人同意而分享敏感和私人信息而“经历了巨大的痛苦”。 她表示，该公司“有义务向其所服务的 LGBTQ+ 社区提供补偿，以补偿那些数据遭到泄露的人”。 两个数据分析服务 Apptimize 和 Localytics 被确定为有权访问敏感数据的第三方。 声明称，可能有无限数量的第三方使用它为 Grindr 用户定制广告。 2018 年，有消息称 Grindr 一直与这两家数据分析提供商共享个人数据，包括用户的艾滋病毒状况。 Grindr 当时为这种做法进行了辩护，称其符合行业标准，但它表示随后停止与这些公司共享艾滋病毒数据。 该公司被挪威数据保护监管机构罚款 550 万英镑，并于 2022 年晚些时候因其数据做法受到英国信息专员办公室的谴责。 该公司在周五提交的文件中表示，自 2020 年以来，它“彻底改革”了其隐私做法，以帮助满足“其……的独特需求”。

reflection.en: The news about Grindr settling claims for sharing sensitive user data, including HIV status, highlights a profound breach of trust. It underscores the importance of ethical data handling and accountability, reminding us that true justice requires not only legal settlements but also a commitment to protecting the vulnerable and upholding dignity in all our...
reflection.zh: Grindr因共享包括艾滋病毒状况在内的敏感用户数据而达成和解的消息，凸显了信任的严重破裂。它强调了道德数据处理和问责制的重要性，提醒我们真正的公义不仅需要法律和解，还需要在所有交往中致力于保护弱势群体并维护尊严。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: War criminal Ratko Mladic buried with military honors in Belgrade, Serbia
title.zh: 战犯拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德获军事荣誉下葬

summary.en: Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, took place shortly before President Vucic was expected to call an election, and was attended by thousands of mourners.
summary.zh: 曾因斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪被定罪的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇已在贝尔格莱德下葬。葬礼通过电视直播，在武契奇总统预计将宣布大选前不久举行，有数千名悼念者参加。

body.en:
Ratko Mladic, the former Bosnian Serb commander convicted of genocide in Srebrenica, has been buried in Belgrade. The funeral, broadcast live on TV, comes just days before President Vucic is expected to call an election.

Several thousand people lined the streets of Belgrade on Monday to follow the funeral service and burial of former Bosnian Serb army commander Ratko Mladic .

Earlier in the day, Serbian Patriarch Porfirije personally officiated at the funeral service for the former general,  who died while serving a life sentence in The Hague for genocide in Srebrenica and other war crimes committed during the violent breakup of Yugoslavia in the 1990s.

In accordance with his wishes, Mladic was laid to rest at Topcider Cemetery beside his daughter, who died by suicide in 1994.

Informer TV, a staunchly pro-government broadcaster, carried live coverage of what it described as a "magnificent farewell," without mentioning the roughly 8,000 Bosniak civilians and prisoners massacred by Mladic's Bosnian Serb forces in Srebrenica in July 1995 .

President Aleksandar Vucic did not attend the funeral, citing a previously scheduled visit by his counterpart from Uzbekistan.

Observers say that the president has tried to chart a middle course on the issue of Mladic's funeral.

Mladic was not buried with state honors, but with military honors, with Vucic insisting that the state was merely respecting the wishes of the family and ensuring a dignified burial.

"Were we supposed to forbid people from attending, forbid the funeral itself and create dog cemeteries?" he said in response to criticism from the EU .

The phrase "dog cemeteries" refers in Serbia to the unmarked graves of so-called "enemies of the people" who were executed by Yugoslav partisans during and immediately after World War II.

Vucic was equally dismissive of the decision by EU Enlargement Commissioner Marta Kos to cancel a planned visit to Belgrade , calling her reaction "stupid." He has brushed aside other criticism of the public glorification of Mladic in much the same way.

An EU spokesman said in a statement that "Any glorification of war criminals, genocide denial and revisionism contradict the most fundamental European values and have no place in the EU or in EU candidate countries."

For Vucic, who has long sought to balance Serbia between the European Union and Russia, the situation is politically delicate.

He is expected to call a snap parliamentary election as early as this week. The poll is likely to take place on October 25.

For the first time in years, there is a credible possibility that his ruling bloc could be defeated by the student movement , which has led anti-government protests in Serbia for nearly two years now.

body.zh: 被判在斯雷布雷尼察犯有种族灭绝罪的前波斯尼亚塞族指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇已被埋葬在贝尔格莱德。葬礼在电视上现场直播，就在武契奇总统预计将举行选举的几天前举行。 周一，数千人聚集在贝尔格莱德街头，参加前波斯尼亚塞族军队指挥官拉特科·姆拉迪奇的葬礼和埋葬仪式。 当天早些时候，塞尔维亚宗主教波尔菲里耶亲自为这位前将军主持了葬礼。这位将军因在 1990 年代南斯拉夫暴力解体期间犯下的斯雷布雷尼察种族灭绝罪和其他战争罪而被判无期徒刑，在海牙服刑时去世。 按照姆拉迪奇的遗愿，姆拉迪奇被安葬在托普西德公墓，他的女儿于1994年自杀身亡。 坚定支持政府的广播公司 Informer TV 现场报道了一场自称为“盛大告别”的活动，但没有提及 1995 年 7 月在斯雷布雷尼察姆拉迪奇的波斯尼亚塞族军队屠杀的大约 8,000 名波斯尼亚平民和囚犯。 亚历山大·武契奇总统没有出席葬礼，理由是乌兹别克斯坦总统此前计划来访。 观察人士称，总统试图在姆拉迪奇的葬礼问题上制定中间路线。 姆拉迪奇的安葬不是以国家荣誉，而是以军事荣誉，武契奇坚称国家只是尊重家人的意愿并确保安葬有尊严。 “我们是否应该禁止人们参加、禁止葬礼本身并建立狗墓地？”他是在回应欧盟的批评时如此说道。 在塞尔维亚，“狗墓地”一词指的是在第二次世界大战期间和战后不久被南斯拉夫游击队处决的所谓“人民的敌人”的无标记坟墓。 武契奇同样对欧盟扩大委员玛塔·科斯取消计划访问贝尔格莱德的决定不屑一顾，称她的反应“愚蠢”。他以同样的方式驳回了其他对公开颂扬姆拉迪奇的批评。 欧盟发言人在一份声明中表示，“任何美化战犯、否认种族灭绝和修正主义的行为都违背了最基本的欧洲价值观，在欧盟或欧盟候选国中都没有立足之地。” 对于长期以来一直寻求在欧盟和俄罗斯之间平衡塞尔维亚的武契奇来说，局势在政治上很微妙。 预计他最早将于本周召开提前议会选举。投票可能于 10 月 25 日进行。 多年来第一次，他的统治集团有可能被学生运动击败，近两年来，学生运动在塞尔维亚引发了反政府抗议活动。 武契奇预计将成为他的塞尔维亚人名单中的首位......

This event raises profound questions about justice and accountability, particularly when such figures are celebrated rather than condemned. The prophet Habakkuk lamented a similar breakdown of justice, crying out, "The law is paralyzed, and justice never...
reflection.zh: 曾被判犯有种族灭绝罪的拉特科·姆拉迪奇在贝尔格莱德举行了军事葬礼。这一事件引发了关于正义和问责的深刻问题，尤其是在此类人物受到颂扬而非谴责的时候。先知哈巴谷曾哀叹类似的司法败坏，呼喊说：“律法被废弃，公理永不显露。因为恶人围困义人，所以公理被屈枉了。”

verse.textEn: The law is paralyzed, and justice never prevails. The wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
verse.textZh: 因此律法放松，公理也不显明；恶人围困义人，所以公理显然颠倒。

title.en: Pakistan: Can creating new provinces fix governance?
title.zh: 巴基斯坦：设立新省份能否解决治理问题？

summary.en: Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution. A debate has reignited over whether the current four-province system can effectively govern a country of around 260 million people, with proposals ranging...
summary.zh: 巴基斯坦人普遍认为国家需要更有效和响应迅速的政府，但许多人质疑仅仅设立更多省份是否是解决方案。关于该国目前的四省制能否有效治理近2.6亿人口的争论再次兴起，提议包括设立12至15个新省份或赋予县级政府权力。

body.en:
Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether simply creating more provinces is the solution.

A politically sensitive debate has reignited in Pakistan over whether its four-province system can effectively govern a country of around 260 million people.  

Ahsan Iqbal, minister for planning and development, recently called for a national political debate on administrative reform. He proposed creating 12 to 15 new provinces or setting up 160 empowered district governments to improve governance and the delivery of public services.

Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi, who first raised the idea of an administrative "reset" in July, said on Saturday that any new administrative units should be created with public support.

Defense Minister Khawaja Asif, meanwhile, has called for greater decentralization and devolution of power to the grassroots.

Despite the growing calls to create new provinces, no formal decision has been taken.

Even within the ruling coalition, there is disagreement over how and when such reforms should be pursued.

There are also questions about whether creating smaller provinces improves governance, or whether devolving power directly to local governments would be more effective.

Pakistanis broadly agree that the country needs more responsive and effective government, but many question whether creating more provinces is the solution.

"Smaller provinces are not a substitute for empowered local governments. Even with smaller provinces, you will still need empowered local governments to make the system effective and improve service delivery to the people," Miftah Ismail, a former finance minister and economist, told DW.

Supporters of creating more provinces argue that Pakistan's four existing provinces — Punjab, Sindh, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa , and Balochistan — have become too large and overly centralized.

Iqbal, the planning minister, has argued that the existing system has not delivered adequate improvements in health, education, and other social services.

Interior Minister Naqvi, on the other hand, has called for an administrative structure that is better suited to Pakistan's growing population.

"Without effective local governments, whether there is one province or 25, decision-making will remain centralized at the provincial level," Abid Qaiyum Suleri, executive director of the Sustainable Development Policy Institute, an Islamabad-based think tank, told DW. 

He said any proposal for new provinces or administrative units should be assessed against potential improvements in local tax collection and the costs of creating new provincial institutions, including secretariats, assemblies, and bureaucracies.

body.zh: 巴基斯坦人普遍认为，该国需要更有反应力和更有效的政府，但许多人质疑简单地设立更多省份是否就是解决方案。 巴基斯坦重新引发了一场政治敏感的争论，争论的焦点是其四省制能否有效治理这个拥有约2.6亿人口的国家。 规划和发展部长阿赫桑·伊克巴尔最近呼吁就行政改革进行全国政治辩论。他提议创建 12 至 15 个新省份或设立 160 个授权地区政府，以改善治理和公共服务的提供。 内政部长莫辛·纳克维 (Mohsin Naqvi) 在 7 月份首次提出行政“重置”的想法，他周六表示，任何新的行政单位的创建都应得到公众的支持。 与此同时，国防部长卡瓦贾·阿西夫呼吁加强权力下放，并将权力下放到基层。 尽管创建新省份的呼声越来越高，但尚未做出正式决定。 即使在执政联盟内部，对于如何以及何时进行此类改革也存在分歧。 还有一些问题是，创建较小的省份是否可以改善治理，或者将权力直接下放给地方政府是否会更有效。 巴基斯坦人普遍认为，该国需要更有反应力和更有效的政府，但许多人质疑设立更多省份是否是解决方案。 前财政部长兼经济学家米夫塔·伊斯梅尔（Miftah Ismail）对德国之声表示：“较小的省份并不能取代地方政府的授权。即使是规模较小的省份，你仍然需要地方政府的授权来使系统有效并改善为人民提供的服务。” 创建更多省份的支持者认为，巴基斯坦现有的四个省——旁遮普省、信德省、开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省和俾路支省——已经变得太大且过于集中。 规划部长伊克巴尔认为，现有的体系没有在卫生、教育和其他社会服务方面带来足够的改善。 另一方面，内政部长纳克维则呼吁建立一个更适合巴基斯坦不断增长的人口的行政结构。 伊斯兰堡智库可持续发展政策研究所执行主任阿比德·盖尤姆·苏莱里（Abid Qaiyum Suleri）告诉德国之声：“如果没有有效的地方政府，无论是一个省还是25个省，决策仍将集中在省一级。” 他表示，任何关于新省或行政单位的提议都应根据地方税收征收的潜在改进以及建立新省级机构（包括秘书处、议会和官僚机构）的成本进行评估。 苏莱里强调，还应该...

reflection.en: The debate in Pakistan over administrative reform highlights a deep-seated desire for better governance and public services. As leaders consider restructuring the nation, the ancient prophetic call to "execute justice and righteousness" serves as a timeless reminder of the core duties of leadership. True reform lies not just in administrative changes, but...
reflection.zh: 巴基斯坦关于行政改革的辩论凸显了对更好治理和公共服务的深切渴望。当领导人考虑国家结构调整时，古老的先知呼吁“施行公平和公义”，提醒人们领导者的核心职责。真正的改革不仅在于行政上的改变，更在于为所有公民切实地施行公义。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Austria's headscarf ban for under-14s faces first test as new school year starts
title.zh: 奥地利禁止14岁以下儿童佩戴头巾，新学年面临首次考验

summary.en: Austria's ban on headscarves for children under 14 is set to face its first challenge as the new school year begins. The law, passed with support from the conservative Austrian People's Party and the far-right Freedom Party, has been criticized by the Islamic Religious Community in Austria as discriminatory and an...
summary.zh: 奥地利禁止14岁以下儿童佩戴头巾的法律在新学年开始之际面临首次考验。这项由保守的奥地利人民党和极右翼自由党支持通过的法律，被奥地利伊斯兰宗教团体批评为歧视性并侵犯基本权利。

body.en:
Austria's ban on headscarves for under-14s faces an initial test as schools reopen in Vienna and other ‌states, with groups including the country's main Muslim organisation denouncing it as discriminatory and legal ‌challenges likely.

Austria's centrist ruling coalition of three parties, led by the conservative Austrian People's Party, proposed the ban in schools, arguing ‌it was acting to protect girls' freedom.

The legislation was passed in parliament in December with the support of the far-right Freedom Party. Only the smallest party in parliament, the left-wing Greens, opposed it.

The group that formally represents Austria's Muslims, the Islamic ‌Religious Community in ‌Austria (IGGO), has ⁠said the move was an infringement of fundamental rights, pledging to fight it before the Constitutional Court, which rejected challenges in July because the legislation had not yet gone into force.

The court ruled in 2020 that a previous ban, which applied to under-10s in schools, was illegal because it discriminated against Muslims ⁠and the state had a duty ‌to be religiously neutral.

Asked by national broadcaster ORF if ‌the court would overturn the new ban, education minister Christoph Wiederkehr said: "You can never be completely certain".

"We in the government carried out very intensive consultations and we in the education ministry tried very hard to write a law that complies with the constitution," Wiederkehr said.

Left-wing ‌pupils' organisations have called for protests. The new school year starts on Monday in three of Austria's nine states — Vienna, the surrounding state of Lower Austria, and Burgenland, all in the east — with the rest following next week.

The legislation stipulates a school must hold discussions with any pupil defying the ban, after which a fine of ⁠between 150 and 800 euros ($A243 to $A1,290) can be imposed.

With anti-immigration sentiment running high in Austria, the government had argued the law was aimed at protecting girls from "oppression".

"It's my decision... No one can force me to wear a headscarf, and no one can force me to take it off," a 12-year-old student told the Agence France-Presse (AFP) news agency at a protest against the ban in Vienna earlier this year.

Malika Mataeva, co-founder of the Muslim Women Network, decried "years of systematic, deeply rooted racism in Austria" at the time.

Roughly eight percent of Austria's nine million residents are Muslim, according to 2021 government statistics.

In March, Austria's education ministry sent out information to all schools on how to...

title.en: Weather tracker: Typhoon Saudel causes mass evacuations in south-east China
title.zh: 台风“苏德罗”导致中国东南部大规模疏散

summary.en: Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to south-east China last week, causing widespread damage and forcing mass evacuations. The city of Putian recorded 416.5mm of rain in 24 hours, leading to the evacuation of almost 600,000 people in Fujian province and affecting thousands more in other provinces.
summary.zh: 上周，台风“苏德罗”给中国东南部带来了数日的倾盆大雨，造成大范围破坏并导致大规模疏散。福建省莆田市在24小时内记录到416.5毫米的降雨量，迫使福建省近60万人撤离，另有数千人受到江西等省份的影响。

body.en: Torrential rain causes widespread damage; while north-west South Africa hit by thunderstorms and central-southern US faces oppressive heat Typhoon Saudel brought days of torrential rain to Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Fujian and Guangdong provinces in south-east China last week. The city of Putian, in Fujian province, recorded 416.5mm of rain in a 24-hour period between Thursday and Friday, with surrounding villages recording more than 500mm in the same period. In Fujian, authorities estimate that almost 600,000 people were evacuated from high-risk, flood-prone areas. A further 128,000 people in 53 counties were also affected across Jiangxi, with emergency evacuations affecting 9,000 people. Flooding, landslips and infrastructure damage were reported widely in the region. More than 2,500 teachers and students were trapped in a school compound in the Zhejiang city of Wenzhou on Wednesday after extreme rainfall caused flash floods in low-lying areas. At least 1,260 people reportedly had to be rescued in Putian after a river embankment collapsed on Thursday, flattening 100 homes. On Saturday, a landslip in a village of Suichuan county, in Jiangxi province, killed three people and nine others remaining missing. Continue reading...
body.zh: 暴雨造成大面积破坏；南非西北部遭遇雷暴袭击，美国中南部遭遇酷热，台风“萨德尔”上周给中国东南部的浙江、江西、福建和广东省带来连日暴雨。福建省莆田市周四至周五24小时内降雨量达416.5毫米，周边村庄同期降雨量超过500毫米。在福建，当局估计近 60 万人从高风险、洪水易发地区撤离。江西53个县12.8万人受灾，紧急疏散9000人。据报道，该地区发生了洪水、山体滑坡和基础设施损坏。周三，极端降雨导致低洼地区山洪暴发，2500多名师生被困在浙江温州一所学校大院内。据报道，莆田市周四河堤崩塌，夷为平地，至少有 1,260 人需要救援。周六，江西省遂川县一个村庄发生山体滑坡，造成三人死亡，另有九人失踪。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Typhoon Saudel's torrential rains and subsequent evacuations in China underscore the harsh realities of natural disasters. In times of devastation, the human spirit is tested, yet the biblical narrative offers a path through suffering. Romans 5:3-4 reminds us that hardship can produce perseverance, character, and hope, even amidst overwhelming loss.
reflection.zh: 台风“苏德罗”带来的倾盆大雨和中国随后的大规模疏散，凸显了自然灾害的严酷现实。在毁灭性的灾难面前，人类的精神受到考验，但圣经的叙事提供了一条穿越苦难的道路。罗马书5:3-4提醒我们，即使在巨大的损失中，艰难困苦也能磨炼出忍耐、品格和盼望。

verse.textEn: We also glory in our sufferings, because we know that suffering produces perseverance; perseverance, character; and character, hope.
verse.textZh: 就是在患难中也是欢欢喜喜的；因为知道患难生忍耐，忍耐生老练，老练生盼望。

title.en: China to pump $54bn into state banks and insurers to boost economy
title.zh: 中国向国有银行和保险公司注资540亿美元以提振经济

summary.en: China is injecting 360 billion yuan ($53.6 billion) into eight state-owned banks and insurance companies, led by the Ministry of Finance. This move aims to strengthen their operational capabilities, risk resistance, and service to the real economy, as Beijing seeks to invigorate the nation's slowing economy amidst...
summary.zh: 中国正向八家国有银行和保险公司注入3600亿元人民币（合536亿美元），此举由财政部牵头。此举旨在增强它们的经营能力、风险抵御能力和服务实体经济的能力，以应对西方国家贸易紧张局势和人口老龄化等挑战，重振本国经济。

body.en:
China is pumping tens of billions of dollars into eight state-owned banks and insurance companies to help shore up the country's financial system and boost its slowing economy.

The cash injection, which is being led by China's finance ministry, will total 360 billion yuan ($53.6bn; £39.7bn), state news agency Xinhua said on Sunday.

The outlet said the move "will help further enhance their sound operating capabilities, risk resistance capabilities, and ability to serve the real economy".

It marks the latest move in Beijing's attempts to reinvigorate the world's second largest economy as it faces issues including trade tensions with the West, the impact of the Iran war and an aging population.

The package will boost the finances of three big lenders and five insurers including the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the Agricultural Bank of China and China Export & Credit Insurance Corporation.

State news outlet Global Times said this "will give banks and financial institutions more resources to channel into credit for the real economy, while strengthening their ability to withstand external shocks at a time of global financial uncertainty".

President Xi Jinping has long seen financial stability as key to China's national security.

This weekend's announcements come as Beijing is aiming to reshape the economy in the face of a number of challenges such as a shrinking workforce, a years-long property market slump and ongoing trade and technology rivalry with the US.

China's economic growth slowed sharply between the start of April and end of June as weak domestic demand and the Iran war's impact on oil prices overshadowed the country's strong exports.

Official gross domestic product (GDP) figures released in July showed China's economy grew in the second quarter by 4.3%, below Beijing's annual target, and after a 5% rise in the first quarter.

In March, Beijing cut the growth target to a range of 4.5%-5%, its lowest economic expansion goal since 1991, a move some analysts say has given Beijing space to acknowledge pre-existing economic weakness.

'Investing in people': Can China's new push to boost spending revive the economy?
body.zh: 中国正在向八家国有银行和保险公司注入数百亿美元，以帮助支撑该国的金融体系并提振其放缓的经济。 据官方通讯社新华社周日称，由中国财政部牵头的注资总额将达 3600 亿元人民币（536 亿美元；397 亿英镑）。 该媒体表示，此举“有利于进一步增强稳健经营能力、抗风险能力、服务实体经济能力”。 这是北京在面临与西方贸易紧张、伊朗战争影响和人口老龄化等问题之际，试图重振世界第二大经济体的最新举措。 该计划将提振中国工商银行、中国农业银行和中国出口信用保险公司等三大银行和五家保险公司的财务状况。 官方新闻媒体《环球时报》表示，这“将为银行和金融机构提供更多资源，为实体经济提供信贷，同时增强它们在全球金融不确定性时期抵御外部冲击的能力”。 习近平主席长期以来一直将金融稳定视为中国国家安全的关键。 本周末的公告发布之际，北京正计划重塑经济，应对劳动力萎缩、房地产市场长达数年的低迷以及与美国持续的贸易和技术竞争等挑战。 4月初至6月底，中国经济增长大幅放缓，原因是国内需求疲软和伊朗战争对油价的影响掩盖了中国强劲的出口。 7月份公布的官方国内生产总值(GDP)数据显示，中国经济在第一季度增长5%之后，第二季度增长4.3%，低于北京的年度目标。 今年3月，北京将增长目标下调至4.5%-5%，这是自1991年以来的最低经济扩张目标，一些分析师表示，此举让北京有空间承认先前存在的经济疲软。 “投资于人”：中国刺激消费的新举措能否重振经济？

reflection.en: In the face of economic headwinds, China's government is channeling significant funds into its financial institutions. This action reflects a desire to foster stability and growth, echoing the ancient call to "act justly and to love mercy." Such economic stewardship, when guided by principles of fairness and service to the people, can lay a foundation for...
reflection.zh: 面对经济逆风，中国政府正向其金融机构投入巨额资金。此举体现了对稳定和增长的追求，呼应了古老的呼召——“施行公义，喜爱怜悯”。这种经济管理，若以公平和为人民服务的原则为指导，可以为真正的繁荣奠定基础。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: The US now has access to more than half Australia’s military bases – could it drag the country unwillingly into war?
title.zh: 美国现在可以进入澳大利亚一半以上的军事基地——这是否可能将该国不情愿地拖入战争？

summary.en: Exclusive reports reveal that US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to over 100 facilities across Australia. Some analysts liken this extensive presence to a 'colonisation' of Australia's military capabilities, with new data mapping the significant US militarisation on Australian soil.
summary.zh: 独家报道披露，美国控制的武器公司和部队在澳大利亚拥有超过100个设施的控制权或使用权。一些分析人士将这种广泛的存在比作对澳大利亚军事力量的“殖民化”，新的数据显示了澳大利亚本土美国军事化的程度。

body.en: Exclusive: US-controlled weapons corporations and forces have control or access to more than 100 facilities across the continent, which some analysts describe as a ‘colonisation’ of Australia’s military. Find a map of them here US military presence in Australia, mapped – video Why can the US access so many Australian military bases? – podcast US military interests control or have access to more than 100 defence facilities on Australian soil, in what some analysts describe as a “saturation” – even a “colonisation” – of the Australian continent. New data compiled by the Nautilus Institute and published by Guardian Australia maps the extent of US militarisation. The US military controls 17 facilities on mainland Australia and has access to 75 more Australian-run military installations. US defence corporations have access to an additional 18. Gathering intelligence, accessing satellite data for targeting information and communications intercepts. Training, including for 2,500 marines on dry-season rotation in the Northern Territory. Pre-positioning warfighting assets such as Osprey aircraft. Logistics hubs holding weapons, munitions and fuel, stored in case of a war in the Pacific. Continue reading...
body.zh: 独家：美国控制的武器公司和部队控制或进入了整个非洲大陆的 100 多个设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚军队的“殖民化”。在这里找到它们的地图 美国在澳大利亚的军事存在，已绘制 - 视频 为什么美国可以进入如此多的澳大利亚军事基地？ – 播客 美国军事利益集团控制或有权使用澳大利亚领土上的 100 多个防御设施，一些分析人士将其描述为澳大利亚大陆的“饱和”，甚至是“殖民化”。鹦鹉螺研究所编制并由澳大利亚卫报发布的新数据绘制了美国军事化的程度。美国军方控制着澳大利亚大陆的 17 个设施，并有权使用另外 75 个澳大利亚管理的军事设施。美国国防公司可以使用额外的 18 个卫星数据来收集情报、访问卫星数据以进行目标信息和通信拦截。训练，包括为 2,500 名海军陆战队员在北领地进行旱季轮换训练。预先部署鱼鹰飞机等作战资产。储存武器、弹药和燃料的后勤中心，以防太平洋发生战争。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The extensive US military presence across Australia, with access to over 100 facilities, raises profound questions about national sovereignty and the potential for entanglement in distant conflicts. Isaiah's vision of nations beating swords into plowshares offers a counterpoint, a hope for a world where military might is transformed into instruments of...

title.en: EU faces 300,000 factory job cuts as China ‘colonises’ supply chains, industry warns

Eurometal forecasts 300,000 manufacturing job losses by the end of 2026 due to escalating competition from China, which...

body.en: Protest using 10 coffins to symbolise struggling manufacturing industry to take place in Brussels Job losses in EU manufacturing will rapidly increase unless Brussels stops the “colonisation” of industry by Chinese component manufacturers, a leading industry trade body has warned. Eurometal predicts 300,000 job losses in manufacturing in the rest of 2026 because of expanding competition from China, which is now enjoying a record €1bn-a-day trade surplus with the bloc. Continue reading...
body.zh: 一家领先的行业贸易机构警告说，除非布鲁塞尔停止中国零部件制造商对工业的“殖民化”，否则布鲁塞尔将举行用十具棺材象征陷入困境的制造业的抗议活动，否则欧盟制造业的失业人数将迅速增加。欧洲金属网预计，由于来自中国的竞争不断加剧，2026 年剩余时间制造业将有 30 万个就业岗位流失，而中国目前与欧盟的贸易顺差每天达到创纪录的 10 亿欧元。继续阅读...

The prophet Amos declared, "Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!" This call for justice echoes in the concerns of workers facing displacement and...
reflection.zh: 由于来自中国的激烈竞争，欧盟制造业可能损失30万个工作岗位的警告，引发了关于经济公正和公平的深刻问题。先知阿摩司曾宣告：“惟愿公平如大水滚滚，公义如江河滔滔！”（阿摩司书5:24）这种对公正的呼唤，在面对失业和经济困境的工人们的担忧中得到了回响。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!

The funds will come from state institutions and are intended to help replenish cash reserves and bolster investment in the stock market.
summary.zh: 北京计划向其金融业注入540亿美元（400亿英镑），旨在支持银行和保险公司应对经济增长乏力的问题。这笔资金将来自国家机构，用于补充现金储备并提振股市投资。

body.en: Beijing wants banks and insurers to bolster investment in stock market as it helps to replenish cash reserves China will inject $54bn (£40bn) into its financial sector as Beijing attempts to shore up banks and insurers in the face of faltering economic growth. A host of financial institutions said they were due to receive billions of yuan in capital from state institutions including the ministry of finance and even the company that runs the country’s tobacco monopoly. Continue reading...
body.zh: 北京希望银行和保险公司加强对股市的投资，以帮助补充现金储备 随着北京试图在经济增长放缓的情况下支撑银行和保险公司，中国将向其金融部门注资 540 亿美元（400 亿英镑）。许多金融机构表示，它们将从财政部甚至烟草专卖公司等国家机构获得数十亿元人民币的资金。继续阅读...

This action raises questions about the stewardship of national resources and the pursuit of economic justice. The prophet Micah reminds us that true governance involves acting justly, loving mercy, and walking humbly with Yahweh, principles that...

The UK government has indicated it will not use taxpayer funds to prevent these layoffs, with the business secretary stating that intervening in business operations is not his role,...

title.en: The world is being driven to the brink by thugs and dictators, but there is a route to a brighter future | Simon Tisdall
title.zh: 世界被暴徒和独裁者推向边缘，但通往更光明未来的道路依然存在

summary.en: The article posits that the world is currently facing numerous crises, including unending wars, humanitarian emergencies, rising authoritarianism, economic inequality, and climate breakdown, leading some analysts to believe we are in the midst of a third world war. However, it suggests that ordinary people possess...
summary.zh: 文章认为，世界正面临着无数危机，包括无休止的战争、人道主义紧急状况、日益增长的威权主义、经济不平等和气候崩溃，一些分析人士甚至认为我们正处于第三次世界大战之中。然而，文章也指出，普通人拥有比他们想象中更大的力量，可以引领世界走向更光明的未来。

body.en: It’s no surprise some analysts say we are already in the midst of the third world war, but ordinary people have more power than we think Don’t look up! The world is a mess. The sky could fall in any day. Unending wars, expanding humanitarian crises, rising authoritarianism, dysfunctional democracies, rampant racial and religious extremism, and unchecked lawlessness cast a dark cloud as the west’s new political year begins. Set all that against a backdrop of staggering global economic inequality, corporate and individual greed, irresponsible government indebtedness, dangerous AI gambles, climate breakdown and proliferating nuclear weapons, and a truly apocalyptic global outlook begins to take shape. It’s enough to make anyone shut their eyes, cover their ears and utter a Munch-like scream. And it’s only getting worse. Democratic leaders who promise a better, safer, more optimistic future – what Britain’s freshly arrived prime minister, Andy Burnham, calls a “ new era of possibility ” – cannot escape this wider international context. Last week’s global bond market upheaval , sparked by external factors, left Burnham’s cash-strapped government struggling with sharply increased borrowing costs before he barely got started. The fact he chose Ukraine for his first overseas trip, while symbolically important, highlighted another grim reality. As a lead opponent of Vladimir Putin’s invasion, Britain now finds itself in a de facto state of war with Russia – and facing attack. Argentina, too, is eyeing UK defence vulnerabilities . These are not the sort of possibilities Burnham envisaged. Continue reading...
body.zh: 毫不奇怪，一些分析人士说，我们已经处于第三次世界大战之中，但普通人拥有比我们想象的更多的力量，不要抬头！世界一团糟。天随时可能塌下来。无休无止的战争、不断扩大的人道主义危机、日益抬头的威权主义、功能失调的民主国家、猖獗的种族和宗教极端主义以及不受约束的违法行为，在西方新的政治一年开始之际，蒙上了一层乌云。在全球经济严重不平等、企业和个人贪婪、不负责任的政府债务、危险的人工智能赌博、气候崩溃和核武器扩散的背景下，真正的世界末日般的全球前景开始形成。这足以让任何人闭上眼睛，捂住耳朵，发出蒙克式的尖叫声。而且情况只会变得更糟。民主党领导人许诺一个更好、更安全、更乐观的未来 — — 英国新任首相安迪·伯纳姆称之为“充满可能性的新时代” — — 无法摆脱这个更广泛的国际背景。上周由外部因素引发的全球债券市场动荡，让资金短缺的伯纳姆政府在刚刚开始执政之前就陷入了借贷成本急剧上升的困境。他选择乌克兰作为他的第一次海外访问，虽然具有重要的象征意义，但也凸显了另一个严峻的现实。作为弗拉基米尔·普京入侵的主要反对者，英国现在发现自己与俄罗斯处于事实上的战争状态 — — 并面临攻击。阿根廷也正在关注英国国防的弱点。这些不是伯纳姆设想的那种可能性。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author paints a grim picture of global affairs, citing 'thugs and dictators' and 'unending wars' as driving forces toward a precipice. In such times, the temptation to despair or retaliate can be strong. Yet, the call remains to actively choose good over evil, refusing to be consumed by the darkness, and instead, to embody hope and constructive action.
reflection.zh: 作者描绘了一幅严峻的全球局势图景，指出“暴徒和独裁者”以及“无休止的战争”正将世界推向悬崖边缘。在这样的时代，绝望或报复的诱惑可能很强烈。然而，我们仍然被呼召要积极地以善胜恶，拒绝被黑暗吞噬，而是要体现希望和建设性的行动。

verse.textEn: Do not be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.
verse.textZh: 你不可为恶所胜，反要以善胜恶。

title.en: How Australia hopes to help the nation that's accused China of 'weaponising tourism'
title.zh: 中国被指控影响太平洋的方式出人意料

summary.en: As Palau faces renewed criticism from China, its president is seeking Australian assistance to diversify its primary economic source, tourism.
summary.zh: 在帕劳再次面临中国的批评之际，其总统正寻求澳大利亚的援助，以实现其主要经济来源——旅游业的多元化。

body.en:
As our boat bobs along clear turquoise waters, the local operator hands us snorkelling masks. You don't need them, though, to see a stunning coral reef and schools of vibrant fish surrounded by historic limestone islands.

In a nearby lake, we swim under the hot sun and among hundreds of jellyfish, some tickling our legs and arms. They're harmless, Palau's president Surangel Whipps Jr, had earlier assured us.

Whipps, fresh from hosting a highly charged Pacific Islands Forum, proudly points to the postcard landscape behind him: "This is my office", he declares.

It's in Palau, a Micronesian nation dotting the western Pacific, with a population of just 18,000, that China has triggered its sting. The reason: Palau is one of just 12 countries in the world to formally recognise Taiwan, a decision that has long angered Beijing, but its wrath was felt on the global stage this week.

Just days before 2,000 people were expected to converge on the island for the 55th Pacific Islands Forum leaders' meeting, China issued a travel advisory to its residents, warning them of "theft" and "a dangerous local marine environment".

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Whipps said it was "unfortunate" that Beijing was "weaponising tourism", an industry Palau is heavily reliant on. More than 40 per cent of its GDP comes from the tourism industry.

"We live in a free world. We should enjoy each other's treasures and treat each other with respect, and I hope that the people in China see that," Whipps said.

"Maybe [Chinese] leadership has a different opinion, but at the end of the day, we're all people of this one planet, and we care about each other."

Palau's ambassador to Taiwan Gaafar Uherbelau says this isn't the first time China has used tourism to respond to diplomatic spats.

"We saw a peak in Chinese tourists that came in, and then all of a sudden we saw a plunge due to this ongoing tension that we got caught in between," Uherbelau says.

In 2015, Palau boasted more than 165,000 visitors from around the world, and more than 91,000 of them came from China alone. Last year, total visitors were just two-thirds of that number, recording just 65,558 people.

But in November 2017, the Chinese government ended chartered flights to the island and ordered tour operators to stop selling package tours to Palau, in what was unofficially known as a "tourism ban". By 2019, Palau's total visitor numbers had halved to just 85,000 and tourism from China plummeted by 63 per cent.

Despite the CCP's efforts, Chinese visitors are slowly increasing post-pandemic, with many instead taking flights to Palau via Hong Kong.

"We've learned to be more resilient against these different shocks...

This situation calls for wisdom and integrity in international dealings, ensuring that relationships are built on mutual respect and fairness, not coercion. Micah 6:8 calls us to act justly, love mercy, and walk...

title.en: Rescuers in Nepal find two more people alive after flash flood disaster
