title.en: Can communities be proteced from melting glaciers?
title.zh: 社区能否免受冰川融化的影响？

summary.en: Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.
summary.zh: 日益升高的气温增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明，迫切需要解决方案以及可能有助于挽救生命的工具。

body.en:
Rising temperatures are increasing the risk of floods and avalanches in mountain regions. The disaster in Nepal and Tibet shows the urgent need for solutions, and the tools that could help save lives.

High mountain glaciers formed in the ice age are retreating and becoming unstable as the burning of fossil fuels heats the climate and leads to a decline in snowfall.

The instability creates the conditions for large glacial sections to collapse, triggering ice and rock avalanches that can dam river valleys before tidal waves of water are released.

Following the glacier collapse that triggered what is known as a mountain tsunami in Nepal and Tibet on August 26 , thousands are still missing and feared dead. Unlike the 2025 glacier avalanche that destroyed the town of Blatten in Switzerland — where nearly all inhabitants were evacuated — a lack of early warning systems in the Himalayas left locals and tourists at the mercy of flash floods .

The causes of glacier collapse are part of a complex web of interrelated changes to high mountain landscapes due in part to rising global temperatures, say scientists.

Levan Tielidze, research fellow in glacial geomorphology at Australia's Monash University, said the Himalayas are not, as is often imagined, a "frozen and relatively stable environment," but "dynamic systems in which glaciers , snow, permafrost, rock slopes, rivers and monsoon processes interact." 

"As the climate warms, these components are changing simultaneously, meaning hazards can cascade from one process into another," he told DW. When rock, ice and water interact in more unpredictable ways on the world's highest peaks, the resulting debris flows "can transform into a catastrophic flood far downstream."

Almost 25 years ago, in what was then the biggest glacial collapse in history, one glacier crashed onto another in the Caucasus Mountains of North Ossetia in Russia. The event caused avalanches of ice and debris that slid more than 24 kilometers (15 miles) and killed around 125 people.

"The Kolka Glacier disaster was one of the early warnings of the increasing occurrence and potential severity of such glacier-related hazards," said Tielidze. 

Meanwhile, the UN says glaciers in Nepalese mountains have declined by one-third in 30 years, which has added to their instability. 

Some research suggests that even if emissions from burning fossil fuels were low enough to prevent the planet from heating by more than 2 degrees Celsius (3.6 Fahrenheit) compared to pre-industrial times, the wider Hindu Kush Himalayan region could lose up to half its glacier cover — compared to 2020 levels — by the end of the century.

For Dipesh Chapagain, senior scientist at...
body.zh: 气温上升增加了山区发生洪水和雪崩的风险。尼泊尔和西藏的灾难表明迫切需要解决方案以及可以帮助拯救生命的工具。 由于化石燃料的燃烧导致气候变暖并导致降雪量减少，冰河时代形成的高山冰川正在后退并变得不稳定。 这种不稳定性为大片冰川崩塌创造了条件，引发冰雪崩塌，在潮水释放之前可能会堵塞河谷。 8 月 26 日，冰川崩塌在尼泊尔和西藏引发了山地海啸，之后仍有数千人失踪并恐已死亡。与 2025 年摧毁瑞士布拉滕镇的冰川雪崩不同，那次冰川雪崩几乎所有居民都被疏散，喜马拉雅山缺乏预警系统，导致当地人和游客受到山洪暴发的影响。 科学家表示，冰川崩塌的原因是高山景观相互关联的复杂变化网络的一部分，部分原因是全球气温上升。 澳大利亚莫纳什大学冰川地貌学研究员莱万·蒂利泽 (Levan Tielidze) 表示，喜马拉雅山并不像人们通常想象的那样是一个“冰冻且相对稳定的环境”，而是“冰川、积雪、永久冻土、岩坡、河流和季风过程相互作用的动态系统”。 他告诉德国之声：“随着气候变暖，这些组成部分同时发生变化，这意味着危害可能从一个过程级联到另一个过程。” 当岩石、冰和水在世界最高峰上以更难以预测的方式相互作用时，由此产生的泥石流“可能会在下游转化为灾难性的洪水”。 大约 25 年前，俄罗斯北奥塞梯高加索山脉的一座冰川与另一座冰川相撞，发生了当时历史上最严重的冰川崩塌事件。该事件导致冰雪和碎片滑落超过 24 公里（15 英里），造成约 125 人死亡。 蒂利泽说：“科尔卡冰川灾难是此类冰川相关灾害日益频繁且潜在严重性的早期预警之一。” 与此同时，联合国表示，尼泊尔山区的冰川在 30 年内减少了三分之一，这加剧了冰川的不稳定。 一些研究表明，即使燃烧化石燃料的排放量足够低，足以防止地球升温超过工业化前时期 2 摄氏度（3.6 华氏度），到本世纪末，更广阔的兴都库什喜马拉雅地区的冰川覆盖率可能会比 2020 年的水平减少多达一半。 对于 Dipesh Chapagagain 来说，高级科学家......

reflection.en: The melting glaciers and subsequent disasters in Nepal and Tibet are a stark reminder that our planet groans under the weight of human activity. Romans 8:22 speaks of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting its redemption. This passage calls us to acknowledge the deep interconnectedness of our world and our responsibility to care for it.
reflection.zh: 尼泊尔和西藏融化的冰川及随之而来的灾难，鲜明地提醒我们，我们的地球在人类活动的重压下呻吟。罗马书8:22说，万物一同叹息劳苦，等候得赎。这段经文呼吁我们认识到我们世界深层的相互联系，以及我们照顾它的责任。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: If Australia has a housing shortage, why are so many home builders collapsing?
title.zh: 如果澳大利亚住房短缺，为什么这么多房屋建筑商倒闭？

summary.en: Several Australian home developers have gone bankrupt, leaving thousands of people uncertain about whether their homes will be completed. The Bathla Group's collapse alone has put over 2,000 apartments in limbo and jeopardized 14,000 more homes, with 3,472 construction companies failing in the last financial year.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚多家房屋开发商破产，令数千人对房屋能否建成感到担忧。仅Bathla集团的倒闭就使2000多套公寓的建设陷入停滞，并危及另外14000套房屋的建设。在过去一个财年里，共有3472家澳大利亚建筑公司破产。

body.en:
Across Australia, thousands of people are waiting to find out if their homes will be built, after several separate construction company collapses.

By far the biggest of those recent collapses has been the Bathla Group , a Sydney developer that’s been one of Australia’s largest affordable home builders.

Owing about $3.4 billion to private lenders, Bathla's voluntary administration has thrown the construction of more than 2,000 apartments into limbo, while jeopardising a further pipeline of 14,000 homes.

Figures released last week show 3,472 Australian construction companies went bust in the financial year to 30 June 2026: one in four (24.5 per cent) of all company insolvencies nationally.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The only good news? The number of builder insolvencies was slightly down for the first time since a steep rise began during COVID.

However, our research has found insolvencies in the construction sector remain consistently higher than in other industries. That makes it harder to build the housing we need.

Australia is falling further behind in meeting the federal government’s 1.2 million new homes goal by 2029.

Official forecasts released last month indicate the target won’t be met until December 2030. NSW — Australia’s largest housing market — may not meet its targets until March 2032, three years late on a five-year target.

There's no shortage of demand for new homes. What we lack is a construction system capable of delivering them reliably, sustainably and at scale.

On Monday, more than 200 of Bathla’s 350 staff were stood down as the administrator continues to work on a rescue deal.

While most of its building projects are in western Sydney, Bathla's collapse is being watched around Australia because of its wider financial impacts.

Like any company collapse, there are specific circumstances involved in Bathla's current woes. Its business model relied on high volumes of low-cost building.

The NSW building regulator has also conducted more than 40 inspections of Bathla sites in recent months, and ordered the builder to fix serious defects in one major development.

Bathla may have taken as many as 1,000 deposits from buyers for homes now stalled. But home buyers aren't the only people affected.

As well as owing money to subcontractors, Bathla owes money to a long list of non‑bank lenders — also known as private credit firms.

This reflects the construction industry's heavy reliance on alternative finance, because banks have reduced their exposure to riskier lending.

title.en: It's been described as 'dangerous' — and Australians may be flying over it
title.zh: “危险”——澳大利亚人可能正在飞越它

summary.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy has warned that Russian airspace is becoming increasingly unsafe due to Ukraine's expanding long-range drone campaign. Despite this warning, dozens of foreign airlines continue to operate scheduled services to Russian airports or cross the country, potentially carrying...
summary.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基警告说，由于乌克兰不断扩大远程无人机袭击，俄罗斯领空正变得越来越不安全。尽管有此警告，仍有数十家外国航空公司继续运营飞往俄罗斯机场的定期航班或飞越该国，可能载有澳大利亚乘客，而西方竞争对手则已绕道而行。

body.en:
Russian airspace has been closed to Australian, European and North American airlines for more than four years, but it has not been empty.

Around 60 foreign carriers still operate scheduled services to Russian airports, and a larger number cross the country without landing, taking the shortest route between Europe and Asia while Western competitors detour south.

Last week, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told all of them to reconsider, warning that "Russian airspace is becoming completely unsafe" as Ukraine expands its long-range drone campaign.

Passengers from Australian airports cannot fly to Russia directly, and Qantas has avoided the airspace since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022. But those connecting through China's Guangzhou or Shanghai airports, or India's Delhi airport, may still spend part of their journey over Russian territory because the carriers operating those sectors retain access.

An independent Russian outlet reported that 27 foreign airlines cancelled flights to Moscow within a day of Zelenskyy's warning. Several of those carriers offered explanations that did not reference the Ukrainian president's announcement, while others were still overflying as normal.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

The airlines with access to airspace come almost entirely from countries that have not sanctioned Russia.

Russia closed its own skies in 2022 to more than 35 countries and territories, a list that included all 27 European Union member states, the United Kingdom, the United States, Canada, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Australia, and New Zealand.

Chinese carriers form the largest group still flying. Air China, China Eastern, China Southern, Hainan Airlines, Xiamen Air and Beijing Capital Airlines all use Russian airspace, principally to reach western Europe.

British Airways' London–Beijing service is around 1,600km longer than its Chinese competitors' equivalent, adding almost two hours.

Gulf carriers have become Russia's main link to the wider world. Emirates, Etihad Airways, Qatar Airways and flydubai all serve Russian cities, connecting Moscow and St Petersburg to hundreds of destinations — including Australia — through their hubs.

Emirates flies to Moscow and routes its Dubai–US West Coast services along a polar track over northern Russia. Air India operates no Russian services but crosses the country on every flight to the US and Canada.

reflection.en: The ongoing conflict creates a complex web of decisions for international carriers. As Ukraine expands its drone operations, the safety of Russian airspace is called into question, prompting a call for airlines to reconsider their routes. This situation presents a stark reminder of the principle to overcome evil with good, rather than being drawn into...

title.en: 'Probably feel worse, not better': Government proposal to change daily habit questioned
title.zh: ‘感觉会更糟，而不是更好’：政府改变日常习惯的提议受到质疑

summary.en: New laws could let you switch off your feed's algorithm — but how is the real question.
summary.zh: 新法律可能允许您关闭信息流的算法——但如何实现才是真正的问题。

body.en:
Your morning scroll could look very different under new draft laws from the federal government, which plan to give social media users the chance to switch off the algorithm shaping their feed.

An exposure draft of the long-awaited Digital Duty of Care is expected this week, which will put the onus on platforms to risk-test their products before rolling them out — with one proposed measure forcing social media giants to let users opt out of the recommender systems that decide what content they see.

But the plan is already facing pushback, with the Coalition and the Greens both flagging problems with the approach from opposite directions, while other experts have welcomed the change but say the devil is in the detail.

Under the new laws, platforms will be required to offer an opt-out from algorithm-driven feeds.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Communications Minister Anika Wells says the goal is choice, not a ban on algorithms altogether.

"A lot of Australians appreciate the algorithm, both for the enjoyment that they get out of it or the utility that they get out of it," she told ABC News on Monday morning, adding that big tech should "offer them the choice in the first place" and "respect that choice".

Companies could be fined up to $109.2 million for breaching the wider duty of care laws, which also require platforms to actively mitigate risks on their platforms.

"People can already opt out of algorithms in their accounts. Why do we need the government here?" he said on Monday morning, accusing the government of using the policy to "silence people" from engaging with content critical of it.

But existing options to opt out of the algorithm are harder to use than that suggests.

"It's not true that you can opt out of recommender systems on all platforms," Tama Leaver, professor of internet studies at Curtin University, told SBS News.

On Instagram for instance, users can toggle to a followers-only feed, he says, but it snaps back to the algorithmic version every time they log back in. A different setting that lets users snooze certain personalised content resets every month.

Where opt-outs do exist, he said they're often "buried" in menus, requiring a "deep dive" to find them.

"The question of what you will get instead is the thing that will decide whether people will try this out or not," Leaver told SBS News.

He said a return to a reverse chronological feed — the model Instagram launched with — would show only posts from accounts you follow, in the order they were posted, and you could reach the end of your feed — rather than today's endless scroll.

But that's a harder sell than it sounds. Fewer people...
body.zh: 根据联邦政府的新法律草案，你的早间滚动可能看起来非常不同，该法律计划让社交媒体用户有机会关闭塑造其信息流的算法。 期待已久的数字谨慎责任草案预计将于本周发布，该草案将让平台有责任在推出产品之前对其产品进行风险测试，其中一项拟议措施迫使社交媒体巨头让用户选择退出决定他们看到什么内容的推荐系统。 但该计划已经面临阻力，联盟党和绿党都从相反的方向指出了这一做法的问题，而其他专家则对这一变化表示欢迎，但表示问题在于细节。 根据新法律，平台将被要求提供从算法驱动的源中选择退出的功能。 您值得信赖的来源，让您了解周围世界的最新动态。直接将免费的每日新闻更新和分析发送到您的收件箱。 通信部长阿尼卡·威尔斯表示，目标是选择，而不是完全禁止算法。 她周一早上告诉美国广播公司新闻，“许多澳大利亚人都很欣赏这种算法，无论是因为他们从中获得的乐趣，还是因为他们从中获得的效用”，并补充说大型科技公司应该“首先为他们提供选择”并“尊重这种选择”。 公司可能因违反更广泛的注意义务法而被处以最高 1.092 亿美元的罚款，该法还要求平台积极降低其平台上的风险。 “人们已经可以选择退出账户中的算法。为什么我们需要政府？”他周一上午表示，指责政府利用该政策“压制人们”参与批评政府的内容。 但现有的退出该算法的选项比所暗示的更难使用。 科廷大学互联网研究教授 Tama Leaver 告诉 SBS 新闻：“并不是说你可以在所有平台上选择退出推荐系统。” 他说，例如在 Instagram 上，用户可以切换到仅限关注者的提要，但每次重新登录时，它都会快速返回到算法版本。允许用户暂停某些个性化内容的不同设置每月都会重置。 他说，在确实存在选择退出的情况下，它们通常“埋藏”在菜单中，需要“深入研究”才能找到它们。 利弗告诉 SBS 新闻：“你会得到什么的问题将决定人们是否会尝试这一点。” 他表示，回归逆时间顺序推送（Instagram 推出的模型）将只显示您关注的帐户中的帖子，按照发布的顺序，并且您可以到达推送的末尾，而不是今天的无休止的滚动。 但这比听起来更难。人少了...

title.en: Homebuyers left in the dark as embattled property developer Bathla confirms major lay-offs
title.zh: 陷入困境的房产开发商Bathla确认大规模裁员，购房者陷入不明朗境地

summary.en: Bathla is among a long list of Australian home developers that have recently entered voluntary administration or liquidation.
summary.zh: Bathla是近期进入自愿管理或清算的众多澳大利亚房屋开发商之一。

body.en:
Property developer Bathla Group has stood down almost two-thirds of its workforce following its entry into voluntary administration earlier this year.

About 213 of Bathla's 350 staff were stood down at a meeting in Sydney on Monday morning, and construction on several projects has halted as the embattled firm clings to life.

Bathla is one of Sydney's largest residential developers, with 45 projects under construction.

Administrators said they had secured short-term funding to keep some of the firm's projects going.

Insolvency adviser Teneo announced it had secured the funding through five lenders linked to the projects, but the amounts and participants were kept confidential.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

Administrator Stephen Longley said the funding would enable Bathla Group to maintain limited operations for a further two weeks while longer-term solutions were explored.

"Our immediate priority has been to secure sufficient short-term funding to maintain a minimum viable operating structure," he said.

"The arrangements agreed allow us to provide the central support required for construction to continue on projects associated with the lenders participating in the funding package.

"Significant work remains to secure the funding required to progress and ultimately complete all projects currently under construction. We will continue to work closely with lenders and other key stakeholders to pursue those arrangements."

NSW Premier Chris Minns said the government was talking with administrators, but defended not spending public money bailing out the Sydney-based business.

Minns described Bathla's corporate structure as strange and highly reliant on debt from private lenders.

"I can't just hand money over to an administrator, particularly when the finances of this particular firm are so opaque and difficult to decipher," Minns said.

"There's been a lot of commentary about the way this company ... was managed and run, particularly the enormous amount of debt it ran up.

"This is a very strange corporate structure involving a hell of a lot of debt, largely collected from private credit, not through the banks and traditional finances."

Figures presented to creditors put Bathla's total debt at $3.4 billion, including $3.08 billion to secured lenders, $130 million to unsecured lenders, $145 million to the tax office and $4 million to employees.

The home developer entered voluntary administration in late August after the NSW government declined to bail it out.

Former NSW building commissioner David Chandler said issues with Bathla were widely known and called the firm a "slow-moving trainwreck".

title.en: The $25,000 loss critics warn lies under One Nation's superannuation plan
title.zh: 2.5万澳元的损失：批评者警告“国家党”养老金计划下的隐患

summary.en: One Nation has proposed a policy allowing workers to divert 3% of their superannuation payments to their immediate income for up to three years, a move critics argue could lead to significant financial losses for individuals in retirement and increased costs for future taxpayers.
summary.zh: “国家党”提出了一项政策，允许工人在最多三年内将养老金缴款的3%直接用于即时收入，批评者认为此举可能导致个人退休后财务状况严重受损，并增加未来纳税人的负担。

body.en:
One Nation's plan to allow workers to extract part of their superannuation as take-home-pay could leave Australians poorer in retirement while charging future taxpayers more, experts and critics warn.

One Nation has proposed changes to superannuation that would allow workers paying rent or a mortgage to divert 3 per cent of their super payments straight to their wallet for up to three years — investing only 9 per cent instead of the current compulsory rate of 12 per cent.

Employers would still contribute 12 per cent, but the nominated super fund would invest only 9 per cent — paying out 3 per cent to the customer.

Payments would be taxed at the concessional rate of 15 per cent rather than the personal income tax rate.

Party leader Pauline Hanson said the policy would give households "breathing room" and would help people to buy groceries, power bills and the costs of raising a family.

Your trusted source for staying up-to-date with the world around you. Get free daily news updates and analysis, straight to your inbox.

"For a full-time worker earning about $90,500, that means around $2,300 a year after tax, or $44 a week, extra in their pocket," she said.

"For a working couple earning $168,000 between them, it is about $4,300 a year after tax, or $82 a week, back in the family budget.

But the policy has been criticised for its potential impact on retirement, with some saying it could leave thousands worse off later in life.

Mardy Chiah, associate professor of finance at the University of Newcastle's School of Business, estimated that it would result in a loss of about $23,000 to $24,000 in invested income.

"If you're earning an average $90,000 salary, the 3 per cent would give you an extra $2,300 a year — which after three years would be $6,900," Chiah said, explaining the calculation.

"This policy essentially gives households more financial breathing room today in exchange for ... much less money invested for their retirement.

"The loss can be quite substantial. You're taking money away from your future self."

A similar loss was projected by the Super Members Council's analysis of the policy, which said a 30-year-old full-time worker on a salary of $90,500 who opts into One Nation's policy would be down $25,000 in retirement superannuation.

The same 30-year-old worker would lose over $18,000 in compounding interest by the time they reach the retirement age of 67.

Super Members Council CEO Misha Schubert said the scheme would damage a person's super and retirement and increase "inflation and interest rates — which would make cost-of-living pressures even worse".

summary.zh: 漁農自然護理署表示，西貢東郊野公園薄扶林郊遊徑實名預約試行計劃在首個週末順利進行。約有1,560人已登記參觀，大部分遊客無需排隊即時進入，並對安排表示滿意， trail 的人流亦有所減少，改善了遊客體驗。

body.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department (AFCD) said things were smooth at Po Pin Chau trail in Sai Kung East Country Park over the first weekend under a real-name reservation trial scheme. In a social media post, the department said some 1,560 people visited the trail with registration over the past weekend. It said most visitors entered immediately without queuing, adding that they were satisfied with the arrangement. “Some visitors also pointed out foot traffic on the trail had decreased compared with before the reservation arrangement was introduced, with notable improvements at the lookout point which was no longer overcrowded – significantly enhancing visitor experience,” the AFCD said in a statement. The department said it will continue to collect on-site data and visitors’ feedback during the rest of the trial period, which covers the weekends in September, the Mid-Autumn Festival and the National Day Golden Week holiday. A detailed review would be conducted after the trial ends to assess its effectiveness and explore long-term arrangement, it said. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 渔农自然护理署（渔护署）表示，西贡东郊野公园破边洲径的实名预约试行首周末一切顺利。该部门在社交媒体帖子中表示，上周末约有 1,560 人参观了这条步道并进行了登记。据称，大多数游客无需排队即可立即入场，并补充说他们对安排感到满意。渔护署在声明中表示：“有游客亦指出，与实行预约安排前相比，步道上的人流量有所减少，观景台也明显改善，不再人满为患，大大提升了游客的体验。”该部门表示，在剩余的试行期间，包括9月的周末、中秋节和国庆黄金周假期，将继续收集现场数据和游客的反馈。试验结束后将进行详细审查，评估其有效性并探讨长期安排。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The successful implementation of the Po Pin Chau trail's new reservation system, which saw 1,560 visitors over the weekend, demonstrates the positive outcomes of thoughtful planning. Committing one's endeavors to Yahweh, as Proverbs 16:3 suggests, can lead to the establishment and success of well-laid plans. This approach not only streamlines access for...
reflection.zh: 薄扶林郊遊徑新預約系統的成功實施，週末吸引了1,560名遊客，這表明了周詳規劃的積極成果。正如箴言16:3所建議的，將人的謀劃交託於雅偉，可以使計劃得以建立和成功。 這種方法不僅簡化了遊客的進入流程，還通過減少擁擠來改善他們的體驗，這反映了在管理資源和公共空間時尋求神聖指引的實際應用。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

Micah 6:8 calls us to 'act justly and to love mercy.' This principle applies when businesses prioritize profit over the well-being and fair treatment of their customers, leading to exploitative situations.

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Elderly woman charged with displaying seditious publications outside flat, remanded at psychiatric centre
title.zh: 老妇被控在家外展示煽动性刊物，遭还押精神科中心

summary.en: An elderly woman has been charged with displaying publications with a seditious intention outside her flat in Tin Shui Wai. Yang Chau-kei, 61, appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday for the first mention of her case. She stands accused of putting up materials with a seditious intention outside her...
summary.zh: 一名老妇被控在天水围的住所外展示意图煽动的刊物。61岁的杨秋记（Yang Chau-kei）周一在西九龙裁判法院首次提堂。她被指控于2024年3月至11月期间，在其天颂苑的住所外——包括公寓门、客厅窗户和楼道内——张贴意图煽动的材料。杨女士此举意在煽动对香港当局和“宪法确立的国家根本制度”的仇恨。

body.en: An elderly woman has been charged with displaying publications with a seditious intention outside her flat in Tin Shui Wai. West Kowloon Law Courts Building. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Yang Chau-kei, 61, appeared at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday for the first mention of her case. She stands accused of putting up materials with a seditious intention outside her apartment in Tin Chung Court – including on her apartment door, on the living room window, and in the building corridor – between March and November 2024. In doing so, Yang intended to stir up hatred against Hong Kong authorities and “the fundamental system of the state established by the Constitution of the People’s Republic of China,” a charge sheet prepared by the prosecution stated. According to local media, Yang chose to defend herself, refusing the services of a duty lawyer assigned to defendants who lack representation. Wearing a black top and black face mask, she said multiple times in Cantonese: “I did not break the law, they framed me” – a phrase she repeated when asked by Chief Magistrate Victor So if she needed a lawyer. Tin Chung Court in Tin Shui Wai. Photo: Wikicommons. So expressed concerns about Yang’s mental state, and asked the prosecution whether she had a history of seeking psychiatric treatment. The prosecution said she had no such record. When asked by So whether she knew she was in a courtroom, and if she had sought psychiatric help before, the defendant continued repeating, “I did not break the law, they framed me.” So adjourned the case to September 21 to give time for the prosecution to order psychiatric reports to assess whether Yang is fit to submit a plea. She was remanded in Siu Lam Psychiatric Centre. Yang faces up to seven years’ imprisonment under the local security law, if convicted. Separate from the 2020 Beijing-enacted security law , the homegrown Safeguarding National Security Ordinance targets treason, insurrection, sabotage, external interference, sedition, theft of state secrets and espionage. It allows for pre-charge detention of up to 16 days, and suspects’ access to lawyers may be restricted, with penalties involving up to life in prison . Article 23 was shelved in 2003 amid mass protests, remaining taboo for years. But, on March 23, 2024, it was enacted having been fast-tracked and unanimously approved at the city’s opposition-free legislature. The law has been criticised by rights NGOs , Western states and the UN as vague, broad and “regressive.” Authorities, however, cited perceived foreign interference and a constitutional duty to “close loopholes” after the 2019 protests and unrest .
body.zh: 一名年长妇女被指控在天水围的公寓外展示具有煽动意图的出版物。西九龙法院大楼。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。 61 岁的杨秋琪周一在西九龙裁判法院出庭，首次审理她的案件。她被指控于2024年3月至11月期间在天颂苑公寓外张贴具有煽动意图的材料，包括在公寓门上、客厅窗户上和大楼走廊上。检方准备的一份指控书称，杨这样做的目的是煽动对香港当局和“中华人民共和国宪法确立的国家基本制度”的仇恨。据当地媒体报道，杨选择为自己辩护，拒绝为缺乏代理的被告指派的值班律师提供服务。她身穿黑色上衣，戴着黑色口罩，多次用粤语说：“我没有违法，是他们陷害我。”当首席裁判官苏维乔询问她是否需要律师时，她重复了这句话。天水围天颂苑。照片：维基共享资源。因此对杨的精神状态表示担忧，并询问检方是否有寻求精神治疗的历史。检方称她没有此类记录。当苏问她是否知道自己在法庭上，以及之前是否寻求过精神科帮助时，被告继续重复：“我没有违法，他们陷害了我。”因此，案件押后至9月21日，以便检方有时间下令提供精神病学报告，以评估杨是否适合提出抗辩。她被还押于小榄精神科中心。如果罪名成立，杨根据当地安全法将面临最高七年的监禁。与2020年北京颁布的国安法不同，本土制定的《维护国家安全条例》针对的是叛国、叛乱、破坏、外部干涉、煽动叛乱、窃取国家机密和间谍活动。它允许指控前拘留长达 16 天，并且嫌疑人会见律师的机会可能受到限制，最高可判处终身监禁。 2003年，第23条在大规模抗议活动中被搁置，多年来一直是禁忌。但是，该法案于 2024 年 3 月 23 日在该市无反对派的立法机构快速审议并获得一致批准后颁布。该法律被人权非政府组织、西方国家和联合国批评为含糊、宽泛和“倒退”。然而，当局表示，在 2019 年抗议和骚乱之后，认为有外国干涉，并规定了“堵住漏洞”的宪法义务。

reflection.en: The case of Yang Chau-kei, a 61-year-old woman facing charges for displaying publications deemed seditious, raises questions about freedom of expression and the potential silencing of individuals, particularly the elderly, who voice dissent. Proverbs 31:8-9 calls us to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are...
reflection.zh: 杨秋记女士，一位61岁的女性，因展示被视为煽动性的刊物而面临指控，此案引发了关于言论自由以及那些表达异议的个人（尤其是老年人）可能被压制的疑问。《箴言》31:8-9 提醒我们：“当为不能言语的开口，为所有孤苦者伸冤。”这促使我们要关注弱势群体，并确保所有声音都有机会被听见，即使它们挑战了既有的体系。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: Driver thanks ‘superhero’ rival for saving him from flaming race car at Shanghai Int’l Circuit
title.zh: 车手感谢“超级英雄”竞争对手在上海国际赛车场将他从燃烧的赛车中救了出来

summary.en: A British racing driver thanked a “superhero” rival for pulling him from the flaming wreckage of his car after a horror crash in Shanghai, saying the quick response saved his life. Loek Hartog stopped and leapt out of his own car to rush to the aid of Ollie Millroy during the...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及对脆弱群体的怜悯。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A British racing driver thanked a “superhero” rival for pulling him from the flaming wreckage of his car after a horror crash in Shanghai, saying the quick response saved his life. Loek Hartog saves fellow racer Ollie Millroy from a burning car in a daring rescue on Saturday, September 5, 2026 in Shanghai. Photo: Ollie Millroy via Instagram. Loek Hartog stopped and leapt out of his own car to rush to the aid of Ollie Millroy during the China GT Championship race at the Shanghai International Circuit, home of the Chinese Formula One Grand Prix. The Dutchman used a fire extinguisher on Millroy’s Ferrari as a blaze raged before yanking open the driver’s door and dragging him to safety. “I am still alive tonight entirely thanks to one man,” Millroy posted on Instagram. “Loek Hartog stopped instantly with no flag marshals or fire crews in sight and risked his own life to get me out of the car,” he added. The 36-year-old Millroy suffered a huge impact in the multi-car crash during Saturday’s race, which resulted in his car erupting instantly in flames. “I don’t remember anything… but I will remember his incredible act of bravery for the rest of my life,” Millroy said. “One day I will tell our three kids this story and Loek will be the biggest superhero in history in their eyes too. “I’m lying here tonight with five broken ribs, broken collar bone, broken hand and finger and a bruised lung, but it could have been much worse. “Thank you Loek. I owe you my life for your selfless act today.” Hartog, 23, played down his heroics in a social media note posted after visiting Millroy in hospital. “It was terrifying and there were moments when I didn’t know if I’d ever manage to get Ollie out,” he said. “But it’s not about what I did. I’m sure many people in my position would have reacted exactly the same way. “The most important thing is that Ollie is okay. Things could have turned out very differently today and I’m truly grateful that they didn’t.” Millroy’s team, AAI Motorsport, said they would “no longer participate in any races organised by China GT” in a statement that criticised safety standards at the circuit. The team said Millroy’s car “continued to burn for more than a minute” after the crash and that “no timely and effective firefighting and rescue operations were seen”. The China GT Championship organising committee said in a statement on Weibo: “We sincerely apologise for this accident and for the subsequent shock and distress it has caused. “We will conduct a thorough review and investigation into this accident, and draw...
body.zh: 一名英国赛车手感谢一位“超级英雄”竞争对手在上海发生恐怖车祸后将他从燃烧的汽车残骸中拉了出来，并表示快速反应救了他的命。 2026 年 9 月 5 日星期六，上海，洛克·哈托格 (Loek Hartog) 在一次大胆的救援行动中从一辆着火的汽车中救出了赛车手奥利·米尔罗伊 (Ollie Millroy)。照片：Ollie Millroy，来自 Instagram。在中国一级方程式大奖赛的举办地——上海国际赛车场举行的 China GT 锦标赛上，洛克·哈托格 (Loek Hartog) 停下来，跳下自己的车，冲向奥利·米尔罗伊 (Ollie Millroy) 施救。当大火蔓延时，荷兰人对米尔罗伊的法拉利使用了灭火器，然后拉开驾驶座车门，将他拖到安全地带。米尔罗伊在 Instagram 上发帖称：“今晚我还活着，完全归功于一个人。” “洛克·哈托格立即停下来，看不到旗警或消防人员，他冒着生命危险把我从车里救出来，”他补充道。 36岁的米尔罗伊在周六的比赛中遭遇多车相撞事故，受到巨大冲击，导致他的赛车立即起火。 “我什么都不记得了……但我会终生记住他令人难以置信的勇敢行为，”米尔罗伊说。 “有一天，我会告诉我们的三个孩子这个故事，洛克也将成为他们眼中历史上最伟大的超级英雄。“今晚我躺在这里，五根肋骨骨折，锁骨骨折，手和手指骨折，肺部瘀伤，但情况可能会更糟。 “谢谢你洛克。今天你的无私行为我欠你一条命。” 23 岁的哈托格在探望米尔罗伊住院后，在社交媒体上发表了一篇文章，淡化了自己的英雄事迹。 “这太可怕了，有时候我不知道自己是否能把奥利救出来，”他说。 “但这与我做了什么无关。我相信很多处于我位置的人都会做出完全相同的反应。“最重要的是奥利没事。今天事情的结果可能会大不相同，我真的很感激他们没有这么做。”米尔罗伊的车队 AAI Motorsport 在一份批评赛道安全标准的声明中表示，他们将“不再参加 China GT 组织的任何比赛”。该团队表示，事故发生后，米尔罗伊的汽车“继续燃烧一分多钟”，并且“没有看到及时有效的消防和救援行动”。中国GT锦标赛组委会在微博上发表声明称：“对于此次事故以及由此造成的震惊和痛苦，我们深表歉意。 “我们将对这起事故进行彻底审查和调查，并得出...

reflection.en: This story draws attention to compassion for vulnerable people. Galatians 6:2 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with practical compassion and welcome, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到对脆弱群体的怜悯。Galatians 6:2提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以具体的怜悯与接纳来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.
verse.textZh: 我实在告诉你们，这些事你们既做在我这弟兄中一个最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。

title.en: Health chiefs disappointed at QMH redevelopment delay
title.zh: 卫生官员对玛丽医院重建延迟感到失望

summary.en: Health Minister Lo Chung-mau expressed disappointment regarding issues with lifts at the redeveloped Queen Mary Hospital, which have postponed the commencement of clinical services. He emphasized the significance of hospital redevelopment projects for the healthcare system and hopes for swift resolution of the...
summary.zh: 卫生部长卢宠茂对皇后码头医院重建项目中的电梯问题表示失望，这些问题已导致临床服务启动延迟。他强调了医院重建项目对医疗保健系统的重要性，并希望问题能尽快得到解决，以尽量减少对医疗服务的影响。

body.en: Health minister Lo Chung-mau has expressed disappointment over problems with lifts at the redeveloped Queen Mary Hospital, which had delayed the launch of clinical services there. Speaking to reporters on Monday, Lo said hospital redevelopment projects are of great significance to the healthcare system. “We are concerned when the new building can be put into use,” he said. “Regarding the delay at the current stage, as a medical professional, I feel a bit disappointed.” Lo said he hopes rectification works can be carried out as soon as possible. “The Health Bureau will support the Hospital Authority and colleagues at the Queen Mary Hospital to minimise the impact on medical services during this process. “As healthcare professionals, we are the users of the building, and it is not appropriate for us to comment on technical details involved.” Chief Executive of the Hospital Authority Libby Lee also said HA staff were disappointed at the delay in the hospital’s redevelopment. She said services at Queen Mary Hospital were unaffected at the moment, but the Hospital Authority would assess the impact of the delay on the hospital’s future development. Edited by Edmond Fong
body.zh: 卫生部长罗仲茂对重建后的玛丽医院电梯问题表示失望，该问题导致该医院的临床服务推迟启动。罗周一对记者表示，医院重建项目对医疗保健系统具有重要意义。 “我们担心新大楼何时可以投入使用，”他说。 “对于现阶段的拖延，作为一名医疗专业人士，我感到有些失望。”卢先生表示，希望尽快展开整改工作。 “卫生局会支持医院管理局和玛丽医院同事，尽量减少在此过程中对医疗服务的影响。作为医护人员，我们是大楼的使用者，我们不宜就涉及的技术细节发表评论。”医院管理局行政总裁李丽仪亦表示，医管局职员对医院重建工程的延误感到失望。她表示，目前玛丽医院的服务不受影响，但医院管理局会评估延误对医院未来发展的影响。埃德蒙·方编辑

reflection.en: The delay in opening the Queen Mary Hospital due to technical issues with lifts is a stark reminder that even well-intentioned projects can face unexpected setbacks. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our work to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish our plans. This principle calls for patience and perseverance when faced with such challenges, seeking...
reflection.zh: 皇后码头医院因电梯技术问题而推迟启用，这 starkly提醒我们，即使是出于好意的项目也可能面临意想不到的挫折。箴言 16:3 鼓励我们将工作交托给雅伟，相信祂会成就我们的计划。这一原则要求我们在面对此类挑战时要有耐心和毅力，寻求神圣的指引来克服障碍，并确保项目的最终成功，造福所有人。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Unidentified Murder review – playful sendup of alien abduction and true crime influencers in Hong Kong
title.zh: 《不明谋杀》评论——香港外星人绑架和真实犯罪网红的戏谑模仿

summary.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling. Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done...
summary.zh: 在这部突破叙事界限的低成本喜剧冒险片中，儿时好友声称目睹了一名学童的失踪。由郭嘉曦和李振杰执导的这部规模不大、结构精巧的喜剧，以一种随心所欲的戏谑方式模仿了真实犯罪爱好者和伪网红，但其出发点是喜爱而非恶意。影片围绕一个（虚构的）25年前的案件展开，该案件吸引了整个香港的关注。

body.en: Childhood friends claim to have witnessed the disappearance of a schoolkid in this low-budget comedy caper that pushes limits of storytelling Modestly scaled and intricately structured, Kwok Ka-Hei and Jack Lee Chun-Kit’s comedy is a capriciously playful send-up of true crime aficionados and wannabe influencers, done with affection rather than malice. It revolves around a (fictional) 25-year-old case that captivates the whole of Hong Kong. Back when they were seven, childhood friends Mark (Ling Man-lung) and Kit (Ronald Lam Tsz-kit) claimed to have witnessed the abduction by aliens of their classmate Ho in the woods of Tung Tau Hill. On the 25th anniversary of this supposed incident, the pair re-enter the internet’s consciousness after an interview on an online chatshow about unsolved mysteries. Cashing in on their viral fame, Mark’s girlfriend Man (Renci Yeung) hires actor Kim (Peter Chan Charm-man) to pretend to be Ho, all in the hope of racking up views on her social channels. Just when the cameras are all set up, Man watches in horror as the staged reunion leads to a real murder … or does it? The film unfolds in a series of increasingly tricksy complications and reversals. All of a sudden, apparent victims are revealed to be scheming masterminds, and vice versa. As most of the actions take place in the forest where the abduction supposedly occurred, the plot derives comic relief from the increasingly blurred line between truth and playacting. Largely shot with handheld cameras, it has a visual style that lends authenticity to representations of online media, though occasionally this distracts from the physical comedy performed by the cast. The constant twists also turn into bit of a competitive sport, meaning the film becomes more of a writing exercise than anything else. Continue reading...
body.zh: 儿时的朋友声称在这部低成本喜剧中目睹了一名小学生的失踪，这部喜剧突破了讲故事的极限。郭家熙和李俊杰的这部喜剧规模适中，结构复杂，是对真正的犯罪爱好者和想要成为影响者的反复无常的讽刺，是出于感情而不是恶意。它围绕着一个（虚构的）25 年前震惊整个香港的案件展开。七岁时，青梅竹马的Mark（凌文龙饰）和Kit（林中基饰）声称在东头山的树林里亲眼目睹了同学何氏被外星人绑架。在这起所谓的事件发生 25 周年之际，两人在一次关于未解之谜的在线访谈节目中接受采访后，重新进入了互联网的视野。马克的女友曼（杨仁慈饰）利用他们的病毒名气，聘请演员金（陈可辛饰）假扮何浩，希望能在她的社交频道上获得更多的关注。就在摄像机全部架好时，曼惊恐地看着这场上演的重聚导致了一场真正的谋杀……是吗？影片在一系列日益棘手的复杂情况和逆转中展开。突然之间，表面上的受害者被揭露为诡计多端的策划者，反之亦然。由于大部分情节都发生在据称发生绑架的森林中，因此事实与表演之间的界限越来越模糊，情节因此而变得喜剧化。它主要是用手持摄像机拍摄的，其视觉风格为在线媒体的表现提供了真实性，尽管有时这会分散演员们表演的肢体喜剧的注意力。不断的曲折也变成了一场竞技运动，这意味着这部电影更像是一场写作练习。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This film playfully satirizes our fascination with true crime and the influencers who amplify these stories. In a world saturated with sensational narratives, Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, honorable, and excellent, rather than getting lost in speculation or manufactured drama. May we cultivate discernment in what we consume...
reflection.zh: 这部电影以一种戏谑的方式讽刺了我们对真实犯罪故事和放大这些故事的网红们的迷恋。在一个充斥着耸人听闻叙事的世界里，《腓立比书》4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念专注于真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事，而不是沉溺于猜测或人为制造的戏剧。愿我们培养辨别力，选择所消费和分享的内容，寻求真理与良善。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Hong Kong pro-democracy activist Joshua Wong pleads guilty in second national security case
title.zh: 香港民主派活动人士黄之锋承认在第二起国安案中认罪

summary.en: Joshua Wong, a prominent pro-democracy activist in Hong Kong, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to charges under the national security law, specifically conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against China. The charge carries a maximum penalty of life imprisonment.
summary.zh: 香港一位著名的民主派活动人士黄之锋周三承认触犯国安法，罪名是共谋寻求外国制裁中国，该罪名最高可判处无期徒刑。

body.en: Wong, 29, is accused of urging foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades and other hostile measures against China Joshua Wong , one of Hong Kong’s most prominent pro-democracy activists, pleaded guilty on Wednesday to conspiring to seek foreign sanctions against Hong Kong and China, a national security charge that carries a maximum life sentence. Prosecutors have accused Wong, 29, of working with the exiled Hong Kong activist Nathan Law to urge foreign powers to impose sanctions, blockades or other hostile measures against China. Continue reading...
body.zh: 29 岁的黄之锋被指控敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁和其他敌对措施。香港最著名的民主活动人士之一黄之锋周三承认密谋寻求外国对香港和中国实施制裁，这一国家安全指控最高可判处无期徒刑。检察官指控 29 岁的黄与流亡香港活动人士罗冠聪合作，敦促外国势力对中国实施制裁、封锁或其他敌对措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Joshua Wong, a young activist known for his role in Hong Kong's democracy movement, has pleaded guilty to charges under the national security law. This situation brings to the fore the difficult tension between civic obedience and deeply held convictions. The apostles' unwavering stance, 'We must obey God rather than human beings,' offers a timeless...
reflection.zh: 香港一位以其在民主运动中角色而闻名的年轻活动人士黄之锋，已承认触犯国安法。这一局面凸显了公民服从与内心深处信念之间的艰难张力。使徒们坚定的立场——“顺从神，过于顺从人”——为这种良心冲突提供了永恒的视角。

verse.textEn: We must obey God rather than human beings!
verse.textZh: 顺从神，不顺从人，是应当的。

title.en: Science & Nature Desk
title.zh: 自然科学

strap.en: Discoveries in nature, climate, health, and the wider cosmos.
strap.zh: 自然、气候、健康与宇宙万象的新发现。

title.en: Park rangers and residents speak up to save Togo's last national park
title.zh: 公园护林员和居民挺身而出，拯救多哥最后的国家公园

summary.en: Park rangers and local residents are speaking out to save Fazao-Malfakassa National Park, Togo's last significant protected area. The park, once a tourist destination known for its wildlife like elephants and monkeys, is facing threats. The narrative recalls a visit to the park and the hotel that once served...
summary.zh: 公园护林员和当地居民正在发声，以拯救多哥最后一个重要的保护区——法扎奥-马尔法卡萨国家公园。该公园曾是一个以大象、猴子等野生动物闻名的旅游目的地，但如今正面临威胁。文章回顾了对该公园及其曾经接待国际游客的酒店的访问，强调了保护这一自然遗产的重要性。

body.en: A few years ago, I drove with an old friend from Togo, West Africa, towards the country's last remaining large protected area, Fazao-Malfakassa National Park. Our destination was the Hotel Fazao, where his uncle had once worked as a professional chef after its opening in 1980. For decades, while the park was managed by the Swiss Franz Weber Foundation (FWF), the hotel had hosted tourists from around the world who came to see elephants, monkeys, and other wildlife for which Africa is famous.
body.zh: 几年前，我和一位来自西非多哥的老朋友开车前往该国仅存的大型保护区——法扎奥-马尔法卡萨国家公园。我们的目的地是 Fazao 酒店，他的叔叔在 1980 年开业后曾在那里担任专业厨师。几十年来，虽然该公园由瑞士弗朗兹·韦伯基金会 (FWF) 管理，但该酒店一直接待来自世界各地的游客，他们前来观赏大象、猴子和其他非洲著名的野生动物。

reflection.en: In Togo, dedicated park rangers and residents are raising their voices to protect Fazao-Malfakassa National Park, a sanctuary for wildlife. Their efforts echo the call to speak for those who cannot speak for themselves, ensuring the survival of creatures and ecosystems threatened by human encroachment. This commitment to advocacy reminds us of our...
reflection.zh: 在多哥，尽职的公园护林员和当地居民正在为保护法扎奥-马尔法卡萨国家公园——一个野生动物的庇护所——而发声。他们的努力呼应了为那些不能为自己发声者发声的呼召，确保受到人类侵占威胁的生物和生态系统的生存。这种对倡导的承诺提醒我们，作为受造界的管家，我们负有责任。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

title.en: AI governance model inspired by Pope Leo XIV aims to put ethics first
title.zh: 受教皇利奥十四世启发的 AI 治理模式旨在将道德伦理置于首位

summary.en: Researchers from the John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin and the University of Eastern Finland have created a novel artificial intelligence governance model. This model draws inspiration from Pope Leo XIV's teachings in his encyclical 'Magnifica Humanitas' and aims to ensure that AI technologies are developed...
summary.zh: 卢布林约翰·保罗二世天主教大学和东芬兰大学的研究人员开发了一种新的人工智能治理模型。该模型借鉴了教皇利奥十四世在其通谕《Magnifica Humanitas》中的教导，旨在确保人工智能技术的开发和使用是安全、公平且充分尊重人权的。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

Researchers at the John Paul II Catholic University of Lublin (KUL) and the University of Eastern Finland have developed a new model of artificial intelligence governance inspired by the teachings of Pope Leo XIV as set out in his encyclical Magnifica Humanitas. The new model is intended to ensure that AI technologies are developed and used safely, fairly and with full respect for human rights.

The normatively grounded hybrid model of AI governance was developed by Professor Stanisław Fel of KUL, Dr. Jarosław Kozak of the Department of Catholic Social Thought and Sociology of Morality at KUL, and senior researcher Marta Choroszewicz of the University of Eastern Finland. It is presented in an article published in the journal AI and Ethics .

Existing models of AI governance have centered on who should control the technology: governments, private companies or multiple actors working together. The authors ask instead which principles should govern the distribution of power and responsibility so that the involvement of multiple institutions does not lead to a situation in which no one is ultimately accountable for how the system operates.

What distinguishes the proposed model is that it combines the participation of governments, technology companies, experts, civil society organizations, citizens and international institutions with clearly defined roles and responsibilities. Their involvement is governed by eight core principles: human dignity, the common good, the universal destination of goods, social justice, solidarity, subsidiarity, shared responsibility, and transparency and accountability.

The authors also show how the model should work in practice. Where AI is used to assess eligibility for social benefits, for example, an algorithm may support the assessment of an application but must not replace accountable human judgment. A specific person must remain responsible for the final decision. Applicants should receive an understandable explanation and have the right to challenge the decision. The system should also be subject to independent audits and oversight involving representatives of the groups affected by its decisions.

The study is among the first academic publications worldwide to develop a model of AI governance grounded in Pope Leo XIV's encyclical Magnifica Humanitas.

Stanisław Fel et al, A normatively grounded hybrid model of AI governance: insights from the teaching of Leo XIV, AI and Ethics (2026). DOI: 10.1007/s43681-026-01336-4

MA in English, copy editor since 2021 with experience in higher education and health content. Dedicated to trustworthy...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 卢布林约翰·保罗二世天主教大学 (KUL) 和东芬兰大学的研究人员开发了一种新的人工智能治理模型，其灵感来自教皇利奥十四世在其通谕《Magnifica Humanitas》中提出的教义。新模式旨在确保人工智能技术的开发和使用安全、公平并充分尊重人权。 具有规范基础的人工智能治理混合模型由 KUL 教授 Stanisław Fel、KUL 天主教社会思想和道德社会学系 Jarosław Kozak 博士以及东芬兰大学高级研究员 Marta Choroszewicz 共同开发。它发表在《人工智能与伦理》杂志上的一篇文章中。 现有的人工智能治理模式集中于谁应该控制该技术：政府、私营公司或多个参与者共同努力。相反，作者提出了哪些原则应该指导权力和责任的分配，以便多个机构的参与不会导致最终没有人对系统的运作方式负责的情况。 该模型的独特之处在于，它结合了政府、科技公司、专家、民间社会组织、公民和国际机构的参与，并明确了角色和责任。他们的参与受到八项核心原则的约束：人类尊严、共同利益、商品的普遍目的地、社会正义、团结、辅助性、共同责任以及透明度和问责制。 作者还展示了该模型在实践中应如何运作。例如，当人工智能用于评估社会福利的资格时，算法可以支持对申请的评估，但不得取代负责任的人类判断。必须有一个特定的人对最终决定负责。申请人应得到可以理解的解释，并有权对决定提出质疑。该系统还应接受独立的审计和监督，其中包括受其决策影响的群体的代表。 该研究是全球首批以教皇利奥十四世通谕《Magnifica Humanitas》为基础开发人工智能治理模型的学术出版物之一。 Stanisław Fel 等人，一种基于规范的人工智能治理混合模型：来自利奥十四世《人工智能与道德》教学的见解（2026 年）。 DOI：10.1007/s43681-026-01336-4 英语硕士，自 2021 年起担任文案编辑，拥有高等教育和健康内容方面的经验。致力于值得信赖...

reflection.en: In an era where artificial intelligence rapidly advances, the pursuit of ethical development is paramount. This new governance model, grounded in papal teachings, seeks to balance technological progress with human dignity and rights. It reminds us that true wisdom lies not just in innovation, but in ensuring our creations serve justice and compassion,...
reflection.zh: 在人工智能飞速发展的时代，追求合乎道德的开发至关重要。这个以教皇教诲为基础的新治理模型，试图在技术进步与人类尊严和权利之间取得平衡。它提醒我们，真正的智慧不仅在于创新，还在于确保我们的创造物服务于正义和怜悯，这反映了弥迦书的核心信息：行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心与神同行。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Bumpy battery surfaces can masquerade as nanoscale ion pathways, misleading material design
title.zh: 凹凸不平的电池表面可能被误认为是纳米级离子通道，误导材料设计

summary.en: A signal that appears to show ions moving inside a battery may, in fact, be an illusion caused by an uneven surface. A KAIST research team has identified the origin of this type of artifact, which can lead researchers to misinterpret what is happening inside a battery, and has developed a method to reduce it. The...
summary.zh: 一个看似显示离子在电池内部移动的信号，实际上可能是由不平坦的表面引起的错觉。KAIST的一个研究团队已经确定了这种伪影的来源，它可能导致研究人员误解电池内部发生的情况，并已开发出一种减少其影响的方法。这些发现预计将能够实现对离子运动更准确的分析，并提高包括固态电池和钠离子电池在内的下一代电池材料开发的可靠性。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A signal that appears to show ions moving inside a battery may, in fact, be an illusion caused by an uneven surface. A KAIST research team has identified the origin of this type of artifact, which can lead researchers to misinterpret what is happening inside a battery, and has developed a method to reduce it.

The findings are expected to enable more accurate analysis of ion movement and improve the reliability of next-generation battery-material development, including that of solid-state and sodium-ion batteries.

A research team led by professor Seungbum Hong from the Department of Materials Science and Engineering, in collaboration with the research groups of professor Jong Min Yuk from the same department and professor Nam-Soon Choi from the Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, has identified the cause of a measurement artifact in nanoscale battery analysis that can be mistaken for actual ion transport.

During charging and discharging, lithium or sodium ions move back and forth within a battery. The speed and ease with which these ions move affect the battery's performance and lifespan. Developing better batteries therefore requires researchers to precisely determine where ions can move freely and where their movement is hindered.

One technique used for this type of analysis is electrochemical strain microscopy (ESM), which is based on atomic force microscopy (AFM). ESM scans the surface of a battery material with an extremely fine tip and measures nanoscale changes in the material associated with ion movement, allowing researchers to indirectly track ion transport.

The problem is that when the surface of a battery material is rough, similar signals can appear even in the absence of actual ion movement. If these signals are interpreted as evidence of ion transport, researchers may incorrectly identify where ions are moving within the material.

To investigate the origin of these artifacts, the team created fine trenches on the surface of an ionically inactive single-crystal silicon sample. This provided an experimental environment in which no ions were moving while the sample surface remained uneven.

The results quantitatively demonstrated that variations in surface height alone can alter the degree of contact between the microscope tip and the sample, producing signals similar to those generated by actual ion movement.

The same phenomenon was also observed in actual battery materials. When the team analyzed a graphite anode and the sodium solid electrolyte Na₂Zn₂TeO₆, the ESM signals likewise varied according to surface topography. This...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 看似显示离子在电池内部移动的信号实际上可能是由不平坦的表面引起的错觉。韩国科学技术院的一个研究小组已经确定了这种伪影的起源，该伪影可能导致研究人员误解电池内部发生的情况，并开发了一种方法来减少这种伪影。 这些发现预计将能够更准确地分析离子运动，并提高下一代电池材料开发的可靠性，包括固态电池和钠离子电池。 由材料科学与工程系 Seungbum Hong 教授领导的研究小组与该系 Jong Min Yuk 教授和化学与生物分子工程系 Nam-Soon Choi 教授的研究小组合作，确定了纳米级电池分析中可能被误认为实际离子传输的测量伪影的原因。 在充电和放电过程中，锂离子或钠离子在电池内来回移动。这些离子移动的速度和难易程度会影响电池的性能和使用寿命。因此，开发更好的电池需要研究人员精确确定离子在哪里可以自由移动以及在哪里移动受到阻碍。 用于此类分析的一种技术是电化学应变显微镜 (ESM)，它基于原子力显微镜 (AFM)。 ESM 用极细的尖端扫描电池材料的表面，并测量与离子运动相关的材料的纳米级变化，使研究人员能够间接跟踪离子传输。 问题在于，当电池材料的表面粗糙时，即使没有实际的离子运动，也会出现类似的信号。如果这些信号被解释为离子传输的证据，研究人员可能会错误地识别离子在材料内移动的位置。 为了研究这些伪影的起源，研究小组在离子不活跃的单晶硅样品的表面上创建了精细的沟槽。这提供了一个没有离子移动而样品表面保持不平坦的实验环境。 结果定量地表明，仅表面高度的变化就可以改变显微镜尖端与样品之间的接触程度，产生与实际离子运动产生的信号类似的信号。 在实际电池材料中也观察到相同的现象。当团队分析石墨阳极和钠固体电解质 Na2Zn2TeO6 时，ESM 信号同样会根据表面形貌而变化。这...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of technology, particularly in scientific research, often brings new complexities and challenges. As Daniel foretold, in the end times, knowledge will increase, and with it, the potential for misunderstanding or misinterpreting findings, as seen with the battery research artifact. This calls for diligence and wisdom in discerning truth...
reflection.zh: 科技的飞速发展，尤其是在科学研究领域，常常带来新的复杂性和挑战。正如但以理所预言的，末世时知识将增长，随之而来的是误解或曲解研究发现的可能性，正如电池研究中的伪影所示。这要求我们在日益增长的信息中勤勉和智慧地辨别真理。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: War drama Pressure depicts D‑day's weather forecast—what we found when we recreated the challenge using modern systems
title.zh: 战争剧《压力》描绘了D日的天气预报——当我们用现代系统重现挑战时，我们发现了什么

summary.en: Meteorologist James Stagg gave what many regard as the most important weather forecast in history in June 1944. The fate of more than 150,000 Allied troops preparing to invade the Normandy beaches on D-Day and the future of the war in Europe depended on Stagg and his forecasting teams. Get the forecast wrong and an...
summary.zh: 气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格在1944年6月做出了他认为可能是历史上最重要的天气预报。斯塔格和他的预报团队的预测关系到准备登陆诺曼底海滩的15万多名盟军士兵的命运以及欧洲战争的未来。如果预报失误，本已危险重重的入侵行动可能不会成功，战争将旷日持久。在朴茨茅斯附近的南威克宫的简报室里，德怀特·艾森豪威尔将军正在等待着这个预报。

body.en: Meteorologist James Stagg gave what many regard as the most important weather forecast in history in June 1944. The fate of more than 150,000 Allied troops preparing to invade the Normandy beaches on D-Day and the future of the war in Europe depended on Stagg and his forecasting teams. Get the forecast wrong and an already perilous invasion might not succeed, prolonging the war. In the briefing room at Southwick House near Portsmouth, waiting for the forecast, sat General Dwight D. Eisenhower.
body.zh: 1944 年 6 月，气象学家詹姆斯·斯塔格 (James Stagg) 做出了被许多人视为历史上最重要的天气预报。 准备在诺曼底登陆日入侵诺曼底海滩的 15 万多名盟军的命运以及欧洲战争的未来都取决于斯塔格和他的预报团队。如果预测错误，本已危险的入侵可能不会成功，从而延长战争。德怀特·D·艾森豪威尔将军坐在朴茨茅斯附近绍斯威克宫的简报室里等待天气预报。

reflection.en: The immense weight of responsibility on James Stagg's shoulders as he delivered the D-Day forecast is a stark reminder of how crucial accurate information can be in moments of crisis. Proverbs 16:3 encourages us to commit our plans and endeavors to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. May we, like Stagg, strive for diligence and accuracy in our own...
reflection.zh: 詹姆斯·斯塔格在做出D日预报时肩负的巨大责任，鲜明地提醒我们准确信息在危机时刻是多么重要。《箴言》16章3节鼓励我们将计划和努力交托给雅伟，并信靠祂必成就。《箴言》16章3节鼓励我们把自己的计划和努力交托给雅伟，并信靠祂必成就。愿我们也能像斯塔格一样，在各自的使命中追求勤奋和准确，并将结果交托给更高的力量。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Survey of young researchers raises concerns over future of science in U.S.
title.zh: 对美国科学未来的担忧调查引发担忧

summary.en: A survey indicates that one-third of young scientists who had planned academic research careers changed their minds in the spring of 2025. Fewer now expect to stay in higher education or work in the U.S., and some question their decision to pursue a Ph.D., amidst tightening science funding and international student...
summary.zh: 根据一项新调查，在2025年春季，计划从事学术研究的年轻科学家中，有三分之一改变了主意。越来越少的人期望留在高等教育界或在美国工作，并且有人质疑攻读博士学位的决定，这发生在科学资助和国际学生政策收紧的背景下。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

One-third of young scientists who had been planning careers in academic research changed their minds in the spring of 2025, according to a new survey. Fewer expected to remain in higher education or work in the U.S., or felt that pursuing a Ph.D. was the right decision.

The survey, recently published as a working paper by the National Bureau of Economic Research, was conducted at a time of tightening government policies on science funding and the presence of international students in the country. The government's efforts in those areas have been stymied by the courts, at least initially.

But the new study suggests the high-profile campaign and lack of a final legal resolution have fueled uncertainty among younger scientists about the prospects for careers here. It also adds to researchers' concerns about the disruption of the partnership between the U.S. government and universities that has driven the nation's leadership in scientific discovery, innovation and economic growth.

The survey, conducted in March 2025, showed that a third of respondents who had previously said they were likely or very likely to pursue a career in academia no longer felt that way.

Similarly, nearly a quarter of those who had previously expected to stay and work in the U.S. no longer felt that was likely or very likely. And finally, when asked whether they were satisfied with having pursued a Ph.D., 17% fewer said they were either satisfied or neutral about the decision compared with six months earlier.

A team including Raffaella Sadun, the Charles Edward Wilson Professor of Business Administration at Harvard Business School, and colleagues from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Monash University in Australia were in the midst of a large study of biomedical lab management practices when the Trump administration began its crackdown on government-funded science and higher education.

"We were running interviews with senior postdocs in the labs, and we started to realize we were in the middle of a pretty big policy change," said Sadun.

"The change was seeping into the interviews and, as we were talking to the postdocs, the anxiety was palpable. They started telling us how the uncertainty of the research funding environment and the policy changes were affecting their own decisions."

Sadun and colleagues had already compiled a sample of 2,466 biomedical research labs across the U.S. and, as strife between the administration and universities mounted, they understood they were in a position to analyze the extent of the disruption in real time.

So they reached out to more than 13,000...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 一项新调查显示，三分之一原本计划从事学术研究职业的年轻科学家在 2025 年春天改变了主意。很少有人期望继续在美国接受高等教育或工作，或者认为攻读博士学位。是正确的决定。 这项调查最近由国家经济研究局作为工作文件发表，是在政府收紧科学资助和国际学生在该国存在的政策之际进行的。政府在这些领域的努力受到了法院的阻碍，至少在一开始是这样。 但这项新研究表明，备受瞩目的运动和缺乏最终法律解决方案加剧了年轻科学家对这里职业前景的不确定性。这也加剧了研究人员对美国政府与大学之间合作伙伴关系遭到破坏的担忧，这种合作关系推动了美国在科学发现、创新和经济增长方面的领导地位。 这项于 2025 年 3 月进行的调查显示，之前表示自己可能或非常可能在学术界从事职业的受访者中有三分之一不再有这种感觉。 同样，近四分之一此前预计留在美国工作的人不再认为这可能或非常可能。最后，当被问及是否对攻读博士学位感到满意时，与 6 个月前相比，表示对这一决定感到满意或中立的人减少了 17%。 当特朗普政府开始打压政府资助的科学和高等教育时，包括哈佛商学院查尔斯·爱德华·威尔逊工商管理教授拉斐拉·萨顿（Raffaella Sadun）以及来自麻省理工学院和澳大利亚莫纳什大学的同事在内的一个团队正在进行一项针对生物医学实验室管理实践的大型研究。 “我们对实验室的高级博士后进行了采访，我们开始意识到我们正处于一个相当大的政策变化之中，”萨顿说。 “这种变化正在渗透到采访中，当我们与博士后交谈时，焦虑是显而易见的。他们开始告诉我们研究资助环境和政策变化的不确定性如何影响他们自己的决定。” Sadun 和同事已经收集了全美 2,466 个生物医学研究实验室的样本，随着政府和大学之间的冲突加剧，他们明白自己能够实时分析破坏的程度。 所以他们联系了超过 13,000 人......

reflection.en: When policies shift and funding tightens, the future can seem uncertain, causing even dedicated individuals to question their path. Yet, the ancient promise remains: Yahweh has plans for hope and a future, not for disaster. May these young minds find renewed purpose and a sense of calling, even amidst changing landscapes.
reflection.zh: 当政策变动和资金收紧时，未来可能显得不确定，导致即使是敬业的个人也开始质疑自己的道路。然而，古老的应许依然存在：雅伟对你们有定意，是要赐下平安，而非灾祸，并赐下盼望和将来。愿这些年轻的心灵在不断变化的环境中，重新找到目标和使命感。

verse.textEn: For I know the plans I have for you, declares Yahweh, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.
verse.textZh: 我知道我向你们所怀的意念，是赐平安的意念，不是降灾祸的意念，要叫你们末后有指望。这是雅伟说的。

title.en: From strays to territory bosses: Epigenetics makes cheetahs adaptable
title.zh: 从流浪者到领地霸主：表观遗传学使猎豹适应性增强

summary.en: A new study on free-ranging cheetahs in Namibia reveals that epigenetic mechanisms may significantly influence how animals develop diverse traits, even with limited genetic variation. This research, published in Molecular Ecology, explores how male cheetahs transition from roaming 'floaters' to territorial 'bosses'.
summary.zh: 一项关于纳米比亚自由放养猎豹的新研究表明，表观遗传机制可能在动物尽管遗传多样性低但仍能发展出不同表型方面发挥重要作用。这项发表在《分子生态学》杂志上的研究，探讨了雄性猎豹如何从四处游荡的“漂泊者”转变为领地“霸主”。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

The findings of a new study led by the Leibniz-IZW on Namibian free-ranging cheetahs (Acinonyx jubatus jubatus) demonstrate that epigenetic mechanisms might play an important role in how animals develop different phenotypes despite their low genetic diversity. The work is published in the journal Molecular Ecology .

Male cheetahs begin their adult lives as so-called floaters. They do not occupy a territory but roam over large areas, either alone or in small groups of up to three brothers. Some manage to take over a territory through deadly fights and become territorial males. Soon after, they alter their phenotype within a couple of months. As territorial males, they become physically stronger, behave more aggressively and move within a significantly smaller area, at the center of which the cheetahs' marking trees are located.

The scientists hypothesized that such changes cannot be explained by genetic differences but might be epigenetically controlled. This means that DNA methylation regulates genes' activity without altering the DNA sequence itself. DNA methylation is the binding of chemical groups to DNA, which can alter the level of gene expression.

For the study, the research team used blood samples, weight and age data from the Leibniz-IZW Cheetah Research Project in Namibia. Blood samples were available from 10 male cheetahs at both life history stages: first, when the animals were still floaters, and later, after they had taken over a territory. This enabled the researchers to identify and compare DNA methylation patterns in the same individuals before and after the transition.

"Our initial hypothesis has been supported," says Dr. Alexandra Weyrich, a scientist in the Department of Evolutionary Genetics at the Leibniz-IZW and one of the two senior authors. "The transition from a floater to a territorial male is indeed accompanied by significant changes in the methylation pattern. It was particularly interesting to see how well the methylated genes grouped in metabolic pathways that were linked to the traits we observed to have changed after the transition."

To rule out the possibility that the changes in methylation patterns were merely due to the advanced age of the territorial males, additional analyses were carried out. These revealed that the age-dependent methylation pattern differs significantly from the patterns of the two "male phenotypes."

"Furthermore, the body measurements of floaters that remained floaters into old age remained largely unchanged. This contrasts with floaters that later took over a territory," explains Colin Vullioud, lead author...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 莱布尼兹-IZW 领导的一项针对纳米比亚自由放养猎豹（Acinonyx jubatus jubatus）的新研究结果表明，尽管动物遗传多样性较低，但表观遗传机制可能在动物如何形成不同表型方面发挥着重要作用。该工作发表在《分子生态学》杂志上。 雄性猎豹以所谓的漂浮物开始其成年生活。它们不占据领土，而是在大片区域内漫游，或者单独行动，或者以最多三兄弟为一组的小团体行动。有些通过致命的战斗设法占领领地，并成为领地雄性。不久之后，它们在几个月内改变了表型。作为领地性很强的雄性，它们的身体变得更加强壮，行为更加具有攻击性，并且在一个明显更小的区域内活动，而猎豹的标记树就位于这个区域的中心。 科学家们假设这种变化不能用遗传差异来解释，但可能是表观遗传控制的。这意味着DNA甲基化调节基因的活性而不改变DNA序列本身。 DNA 甲基化是化学基团与 DNA 的结合，可以改变基因表达水平。 在这项研究中，研究小组使用了纳米比亚莱布尼兹-IZW猎豹研究项目的血液样本、体重和年龄数据。我们从 10 只雄性猎豹的两个生命史阶段获取了血液样本：首先是当这些动物还是漂浮者时，后来是在它们占领领地之后。这使得研究人员能够识别和比较同一个体在转变前后的 DNA 甲基化模式。 “我们最初的假设得到了支持，”莱布尼茨-IZW 进化遗传学系的科学家、两位资深作者之一亚历山德拉·韦里奇 (Alexandra Weyrich) 博士说。 “从漂浮雄性到领地雄性的转变确实伴随着甲基化模式的显着变化。特别有趣的是，观察甲基化基因在代谢途径中的分组情况，这些途径与我们观察到的转变后发生的性状变化有关。” 为了排除甲基化模式的变化仅仅是由于领地雄性的高龄所致的可能性，进行了额外的分析。这些表明年龄依赖性甲基化模式与两种“男性表型”的模式显着不同。 “此外，一直到老年的飞蚊症患者的身体尺寸基本保持不变。这与后来占据一定领地的飞蚊症形成鲜明对比，”主要作者 Colin Vullioud 解释道。

reflection.en: Observing the intricate ways life adapts, like the cheetahs' epigenetic flexibility, reminds us of the profound wisdom embedded in Yahweh's creation. The study highlights how even within limited genetic frameworks, life finds ways to flourish and adapt, a testament to the Creator's intricate design. This scientific exploration into epigenetics offers a...
reflection.zh: 观察生命适应的复杂方式，例如猎豹的表观遗传灵活性，让我们想起雅伟创造物中蕴含的深刻智慧。这项研究强调，即使在有限的遗传框架内，生命也能找到繁荣和适应的方法，这是造物主精巧设计的明证。 这项对表观遗传学的科学探索，让我们得以一窥造物主的创造力，展示了生命的适应性是如何编织在其本质之中的，远远超出了简单的遗传继承。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Gaps in evidence on vaccinating badgers against TB, researchers say
title.zh: 研究人员称疫苗接种獾类以对抗牛结核病证据存在不足

summary.en: Researchers are calling for more monitoring of how badger vaccinations affect bovine tuberculosis and for a review of the existing evidence, stating there are significant gaps in knowledge that reduce the method's effectiveness.
summary.zh: 研究人员呼吁加强对獾类疫苗接种影响牛结核病的监测，并审查现有证据，指出知识和证据存在重大差距，降低了该方法的有效性。

body.en:
There are "significant gaps" in knowledge and evidence about the effect of vaccinating badgers in Wales against bovine tuberculosis (TB), according to researchers.

A team from the British Ecological Society's Wales policy group, along with staff from Cardiff and Aberystwyth universities, argue the gaps reduce the effectiveness of this method of trying to deal with the disease.

Vaccination is part of a programme to eradicate bovine TB in Wales, but it is a controversial topic.

The Welsh government said it was "renewing" its approach to eradicating bovine TB.

There have been calls for alternative methods to vaccination for controlling the infection among cattle, such as badger culling, as they can carry the disease and transmit it to cattle.

Cattle are regularly tested for the presence of the infection and are slaughtered if they are found to be carriers.

They are calling for increased monitoring of the vaccination's impact, a review of the evidence, and collaboration with farmers "to ensure the greatest possible impact" from the programmes.

In their policy briefing, they say "major questions remain about how many badgers are being vaccinated, what impact vaccinating badgers is having on disease levels in cattle, and how confidence in vaccination can be improved among farmers and veterinary professionals".

Dr Niall McKeown, a lecturer in the department of life sciences at Aberystwyth University and vice-chair of the British Ecological Society's Wales policy group, said the infection "remains one of the biggest animal health challenges facing Wales".

"Badger vaccination should not be presented as a stand-alone route to eradicating bovine tuberculosis," said McKeown.

"There is strong evidence that BCG vaccination protects badgers, but evidence that operational vaccination programmes reduce disease in cattle remains limited.

"Any cattle-level benefit is likely to depend on sustained and sufficiently extensive vaccination coverage alongside effective cattle controls."

He emphasised it was not simply more vaccination that was needed "but vaccination that is better targeted, measured and evaluated".

"By combining non-invasive genetic monitoring with sett surveys, camera traps and movement data, we can estimate local badger numbers, check the proportion of the population reached and identify significant gaps," he added.

A spokesperson for the Welsh government said: "We are renewing our approach to eradicating bovine TB in Wales, focusing on three main elements: cattle, people, and wildlife.

"This work will be evidence-based and science-led, taking into account advice from the programme board and the technical advisory group, while ensuring that value for money remains a core consideration in decision-making."

Last month, Llyr Gruffydd, the...
body.zh: 研究人员表示，关于威尔士獾疫苗接种对牛结核病（TB）效果的了解和证据存在“重大差距”。 英国生态学会威尔士政策小组的一个团队以及卡迪夫大学和阿伯里斯特威斯大学的工作人员认为，这些差距降低了这种应对这种疾病的方法的有效性。 疫苗接种是威尔士根除牛结核病计划的一部分，但这是一个有争议的话题。 威尔士政府表示正在“更新”根除牛结核病的方法。 有人呼吁采用疫苗接种以外的替代方法来控制牛群感染，例如扑杀獾，因为它们可以携带疾病并将其传播给牛群。 定期对牛进行检测以确定是否存在感染，如果发现是携带者，则将其宰杀。 他们呼吁加强对疫苗接种影响的监测、对证据的审查以及与农民的合作，“以确保该计划产生最大可能的影响”。 他们在政策简报中表示，“主要问题仍然是有多少獾正在接种疫苗，獾接种疫苗对牛的疾病水平有何影响，以及如何提高农民和兽医专业人员对疫苗接种的信心”。 阿伯里斯特威斯大学生命科学系讲师、英国生态学会威尔士政策小组副主席尼尔·麦基翁博士表示，这种感染“仍然是威尔士面临的最大动物健康挑战之一”。 “獾疫苗接种不应作为根除牛结核病的独立途径，”麦基翁说。 “有强有力的证据表明卡介苗疫苗接种可以保护獾，但有效的疫苗接种计划减少牛疾病的证据仍然有限。 “任何牛水平的效益都可能取决于持续且足够广泛的疫苗接种覆盖率以及有效的牛控制。” 他强调，需要的不仅仅是更多的疫苗接种，“而是更有针对性、更好地衡量和评估的疫苗接种”。 “通过将非侵入性基因监测与设置调查、相机陷阱和运动数据相结合，我们可以估计当地獾的数量，检查达到的种群比例并确定显着的差距，”他补充道。 威尔士政府发言人表示：“我们正在更新根除威尔士牛结核病的方法，重点关注三个主要因素：牛、人和野生动物。 “这项工作将以证据为基础，以科学为主导，同时考虑项目委员会和技术咨询小组的建议，同时确保物有所值仍然是决策的核心考虑因素。” 上个月，Llyr Gruffydd...

reflection.en: In Wales, researchers are highlighting significant gaps in the evidence supporting badger vaccination as a strategy against bovine TB. They urge for more monitoring and a review, suggesting that current knowledge may not fully support the policy. This situation underscores the importance of thorough investigation and wise counsel when implementing public...
reflection.zh: 在威尔士，研究人员指出，支持通过疫苗接种獾类来对抗牛结核病的证据存在重大不足。他们敦促加强监测和审查，认为目前的知识可能并不完全支持该政策。这种情况凸显了在实施公共卫生措施时，进行彻底调查和寻求明智建议的重要性，以确保决策有坚实的数据支持。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Public asked to have their say on proposed new renewable energy company
title.zh: 公众被要求就拟议的新可再生能源公司发表意见

summary.en: Plans are being put forward for a new renewable energy company to be owned by the Welsh government. The company would develop and own wind and solar plants, and support local communities to take an ownership stake. The Welsh government hopes it can reduce the cost of energy in the long-term, but the company would not...
summary.zh: 威尔士政府正在提出一项关于成立一家新的可再生能源公司的计划。该公司将开发和拥有风能和太阳能发电厂，并支持当地社区获得所有权股份。威尔士政府希望此举能从长远来看降低能源成本，但该公司本身不会直接设定能源价格。政府正就该公司的运营方式征求公众意见。

body.en:
People across the country are being asked to have their say on proposals for a new renewable energy company owned by the Welsh government.

It would "develop and own" wind and solar plants, and support local communities to take an ownership stake.

The Plaid Cymru-led Welsh government hope it can reduce the cost of bills in the long term, but the company would not directly set energy prices.

It does not set out to replace the organisations that provide energy direct to customers, with the government inviting people for views on how it should operate.

The Welsh government already owns a renewable onshore wind and solar developer - Trydan Gwyrdd Cymru , external (TGC).

Ministers in Cardiff are proposing to bring TGC together with other existing Welsh energy schemes, such as Ynni Cymru, which aims to expand locally-owned renewables and the government's energy service.

Enterprise Minister Adam Price told BBC Radio Wales Breakfast the government wanted an energy system that was "clean, cheap and owned by us".

The company would not "replace existing energy suppliers or directly set household electricity prices", it said in a consultation document.

It added that its purpose would be to "help Wales reduce energy costs over time by developing and owning renewable energy assets" and "supporting local and community ownership, investing in smart local energy systems".

It would also "help more organisations use locally generated energy" and try to attract investment into Welsh energy infrastructure.

The company would be separate from Great British Energy , which the UK government set up in 2024.

TGC is working on a number of projects on land owned by the Welsh government, including proposed wind farms at Carreg Wen near Aberdare and Glyn Cothi in Carmarthenshire.

The consultation asks if TGC should form the basis of the new company and whether it should use its name or call itself Ynni Cymru , external .

It also proposes that the company could take stakes in larger schemes - suggesting this could involve offshore wind, marine energy and nuclear.

The consultation looks at establishing a Welsh Energy Wealth Fund to allow energy projects "to support the most vulnerable in Wales as well as those living in areas where projects are being delivered".

Speaking to BBC Radio Wales Breakfast , Price said: "Our vision for the future of the energy system in Wales is one in which it's clean, it's cheap and it's owned by us."

He said the organisation was bringing the different elements together "to create a single company that, if you like, has the range of expertise and the sort of critical mass of resources and knowledge to make a real difference".

body.zh: 全国各地的人们被要求对威尔士政府拥有的一家新的可再生能源公司的提案发表意见。 它将“开发和拥有”风能和太阳能发电厂，并支持当地社区持有所有权股份。 格莱德·西姆鲁领导的威尔士政府希望能够长期降低电费成本，但该公司不会直接制定能源价格。 它并不打算取代直接向客户提供能源的组织，而是政府邀请人们就其运作方式征求意见。 威尔士政府已经拥有一家可再生陆上风能和太阳能开发商——Trydan Gwyrdd Cymru，外部（TGC）。 卡迪夫的部长们提议将 TGC 与其他现有的威尔士能源计划结合起来，例如 Ynni Cymru，该计划旨在扩大当地拥有的可再生能源和政府的能源服务。 企业部长亚当·普莱斯 (Adam Price) 告诉英国广播公司威尔士早餐电台，政府希望建立一个“清洁、廉价且归我们所有”的能源系统。 该公司在一份咨询文件中表示，该公司不会“取代现有的能源供应商或直接设定家庭电价”。 它补充说，其目的是“通过开发和拥有可再生能源资产，帮助威尔士随着时间的推移降低能源成本”和“支持当地和社区所有权，投资当地智能能源系统”。 它还将“帮助更多组织使用当地产生的能源”，并试图吸引对威尔士能源基础设施的投资。 该公司将与英国政府于 2024 年设立的 Great Britain Energy 分开。 TGC 正在威尔士政府拥有的土地上开展多个项目，包括拟在阿伯代尔附近的 Carreg Wen 和卡马森郡的 Glyn Cothi 建造风电场。 咨询询问是否应以 TGC 为新公司的基础，以及是否应使用其名称或称自己为 Ynni Cymru（外部）。 它还提议该公司可以参股更大的计划——这可能涉及海上风电、海洋能源和核能。 此次磋商着眼于建立威尔士能源财富基金，以允许能源项目“支持威尔士最弱势群体以及生活在项目交付地区的人们”。 普莱斯在接受英国广播公司威尔士早餐电台采访时表示：“我们对威尔士能源系统未来的愿景是清洁、廉价且由我们拥有。” 他表示，该组织正在将不同的要素整合在一起，“创建一家公司，如果你愿意的话，它拥有一系列的专业知识以及足够的资源和知识，可以产生真正的影响”。 普莱斯说，威尔士是“工业革命时期的煤炭能源巨头，但不幸的是我们没有看到......

reflection.en: The Welsh government is seeking public input on a new renewable energy company, aiming for long-term cost reduction. This initiative reflects a commitment to planning and developing resources for the future. As they embark on this venture, may their efforts be guided by wisdom and a dedication to serving the people, trusting that Yahweh will establish their...

title.en: Study to reveal more about Guernsey's wild ferrets
title.zh: 研究揭示更多关于根西岛野性雪貂的信息

summary.en: A conservation group has spent a year studying wild ferrets after securing government funds. The results are expected to reveal more about the population than ever before, using specialist camera equipment to track the animals and analyze thousands of photos.
summary.zh: 一个保护组织在获得政府资助后，花了一年时间研究野生的雪貂。研究结果预计将比以往任何时候都更深入地揭示该地区雪貂种群的信息，他们使用了专业的摄像设备来追踪这些动物并分析了数千张照片。

body.en:
The results of a year-long research project are expected to reveal more about Guernsey's wild ferret population than ever, project leaders have said.

Using money from the government's Strategy for Nature fund, La Société Guernesiaise has been tracking the animals by using specialist camera equipment.

The conservation charity said it plotted where devices should be located in areas where ferrets had been known to attack different wildlife, such as La Claire Mare Nature Reserve in St Peters, had taken thousands of photos and the pictures were now being examined.

La Société said it had been aware of the feral ferret population for some time, but "didn't know anything about them".

The charity was one of 11 local projects to be given funding from the Strategy for Nature last year , and applied for cash to buy 15 camera traps.

The traps were motion-activated and used to take photos or videos of wildlife and people without anyone having to be there to operate them, project leaders said.

Leah Cottell, who has been leading the study, said the process had been "incredibly time-consuming" but she had learned a lot.

"I knew that we had ferrets on the island, but we didn't really know anything about them," she told BBC Guernsey.

"They seem to like being around water sites because they like eating things like eggs, and so they'll go for the nests of ground-nesting birds."

"They are an invasive species, and the feeling is that it's probably due to releases from domestic ferrets.

"They look like their polecat wild counterparts, so they have been out there for a very long time; or ferret owners in the 1980s might have let some go and over time it's expanded."

Cottell added it would take "months and months" to sift through all the photos, but the charity would write up a report of its findings.

The next round of Strategy for Nature funding is open, and people wishing to apply for money had until 25 October, fund bosses said.

Follow BBC Guernsey on X , external and Facebook , external and Instagram , external . Send your story ideas to channel.islands@bbc.co.uk , external .
body.zh: 项目负责人表示，为期一年的研究项目的结果预计将比以往更多地揭示根西岛野生雪貂种群的情况。 利用政府自然战略基金的资金，La Société Guernsiaise 一直使用专业的摄像设备来追踪这些动物。 该保护慈善机构表示，它在已知雪貂会攻击不同野生动物的地区（例如圣彼得斯的拉克莱尔梅尔自然保护区）绘制了设备应放置的位置，并拍摄了数千张照片，目前正在检查这些照片。 La Société表示，他们已经注意到野生雪貂的数量有一段时间了，但“对它们一无所知”。 该慈善机构是去年获得自然战略资助的 11 个当地项目之一，并申请现金购买了 15 个相机陷阱。 项目负责人表示，这些陷阱是动作激活的，用于拍摄野生动物和人类的照片或视频，无需任何人在场操作。 领导这项研究的利亚·科特尔表示，这个过程“非常耗时”，但她学到了很多东西。 “我知道岛上有雪貂，但我们对它们一无所知，”她告诉英国广播公司根西岛。 “它们似乎喜欢呆在水源附近，因为它们喜欢吃鸡蛋之类的东西，所以它们会去寻找地面筑巢鸟类的巢穴。” “它们是一种入侵物种，感觉这可能是由于家养雪貂的释放造成的。 “它们看起来就像野生的鸡貂同类，所以它们已经在那里呆了很长时间了；或者 20 世纪 80 年代的雪貂主人可能会放走一些雪貂，随着时间的推移，雪貂的规模会扩大。” 科特尔补充说，筛选所有照片需要“数月又数月”的时间，但该慈善机构将撰写一份调查结果报告。 基金负责人表示，下一轮自然战略资金已开放，希望申请资金的人必须在 10 月 25 日之前截止。 在 X、external 和 Facebook、external 和 Instagram、external 上关注 BBC Guernsey。将您的故事创意发送至外部的channel.islands@bbc.co.uk。

reflection.en: The dedicated work of La Société Guernesiaise in studying Guernsey's wild ferrets is a testament to the wisdom found in observing Yahweh's creation. Even in seemingly small or overlooked creatures, there is much to learn about the intricate systems Yahweh has designed.
reflection.zh: 根西岛的野生雪貂研究项目，是拉索塞特·格恩西埃斯协会（La Société Guernesiaise）辛勤工作的成果，这证明了观察雅伟的创造物可以获得智慧。即使是在看似渺小或被忽视的生物身上，也能学到许多关于雅伟所设计的复杂系统的知识。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

body.en: Volunteer ‘glow-getters’ overseeing reintroduction of endangered beetles at Nosterfield nature reserve The bioluminescent beams of “fairy folk” are shining again from a nature reserve in North Yorkshire for the first time in a century after the successful reintroduction of endangered glowworms. Female glowworms were spotted over multiple weeks at Nosterfield nature reserve this summer following a no-frills, almost zero-budget reintroduction of the much-loved invertebrates, which have vanished from the British countryside in recent decades and are notoriously difficult to re-establish.
